What happened to when I could open the app and immediately start chatting? It was so natural and it provided comfort. I would no longer ever recommend this app. Everything costs now. I no longer feel cared for by the developers. The AI no longer truly & throughly helps. There are so many problems I can't list them all in this review :(

I love this app so much and I strogly enjoy using it. it helps out with very difficult times. the app user interface is beautiful and seamless, very simplistic in a way and doesnt stress the user out with too much. BUT the one thing that truly drives me a bit crazy is that im unable to access and use my accoug from a computer or some form of desktop application. Typing on a computer is what makes some people comfortable and I feel that is the next step this app should take to improve availability

This was a good app. You opened it, it started chatting with you to take down your mood. Use notifications to check in on your goals. Then they updated it to clutter up the screen and require you to make additional decisions and clicks before using it. And then they started to sell an additional service (it's already a paid app) that takes over the notification system! You can't opt out of not receiving advertisements, so I had to block all notifications. And now it just plain won't open at all.

After ~7 wks on Youper, I've found this to be an awesome app for mood-tracking, mindfulness, & self-reflection. The AI's tone is reassuring & never judgmental. I love that you can choose how much you interact with the app each session, depending on how much time you want to set aside. My critiques: I wish you could pick multiple moods at once, & that the question "What are the factors for this?" was rephrased so you could track all possible patterns, whether they're seen as "causal" or not.

This is a good app for therapy for those that can't afford. It can get repetitive with the responses from the AI but I'm sure the technology is still new.  Offers good advice and is pro-active in giving you options to express your issues. The thought traps is go overs opens up your eyes to what's going on beyond the surface of your thoughts. I would recommend this to friends.

My experience with this app was just okay. It, unsurprisingly seems cold, robotic, and scripted. The AI interface wasn't anything more than Google speak. It gives generic answers to the user's response. It held my attention for 20 minuets, about the time to realize the lack of mental health benifits it offered. I would recommend this to a lonely person, or one that is easily satisfied. There's also a lack of feelings you can choose from, rather than making and submitting your own.

Leaving 3 stars because it clearly seems to help a lot of people, but like the response I see the devs leaving on other less than 4 star reviews, it's not a good fit for me. It's AI and it felt false and invasive. And I'm a little older - I don't enjoy texting, chatting, dms, etc. They're an annoying but necessary part of my modern life, and that's fine, but the polar opposite of what I'd want in any type of therapeutic experience. I'm sure it's great for everyone who says it is, just not for me. Best of luck!

After reading many articles about the increase in AI/psychotherapy apps, I downloaded several to explore. I evaluated them across features such as cost, interactivity, integration with other apps (ability to back up), reminders, and (most importantly) the soundness of scientific research used in their development. Youper ranked superior among them. Youper has a huge psycheducational component which is important for anyone seeking to improve their mental wellness. The information is comprehensive for lay people but not tedious for those with extensive backgrounds in psychology. Interface wise, the Youper AI dialogue is flexible (and improving!) particularly compared to "cuter" AI apps. I was also impressed by the mood tracking and inventory screeners available. However, I was even more impressed with the "therapy" aspects, including elements of CBT, mindfulness training, and possibly others I haven't seen yet. I'm sure it is written in some disclaimer that this app is not a substitute for actual medical or psychiatric treatment by a qualified professional. However, not all people have the resources or access to treatment. Some are not "ready" to address their mental health needs openly. This app can be an excellent first-aid/maintenance program for many... But even for those not suffering from mental health issues, this can be a great way to track what *keeps* you mentally healthy and how to sustain wellness in times of stress. Give it a try?

I've had Youper on and off for the past 2.5 years. Out of every self-help app I've tried, Youper has always been the one to bring me back. I'm pretty sure I left five stars before, but they deserve a second set 😊 Thank you all for helping me become a better person ❤️ Some of my favorite features: - sleek, relaxing and friendly interface - the daily check ins have helped me think through a lot of problems. Things i would change: - nothing

It's hard to evaluate the quality of the service, because the quality of the app is so poor. It is very slow and crashes often, which ends any chat that you're in the middle of. Navigating the app is frustrating, too. Tapping back often ends up at a blank page that can only be fixed by force-closing the app. I can't get the sleep sounds to work, either. This may be a helpful service, but the app (on Android, at least) makes it frustrating to use.

I've been using this app for a month now and it is very helpful. I enjoy it!! I've also noticed a big difference in myself and the way I think and respond. I can't wait to see how much more it will help. Doctors keep trying to give me meds like antidepressants, but I don't want to take them. I'm determined to do this myself with permanent solutions rather than a temporary one with meds. It's a tough road to recovery, but worth it ten told! I can thank Youper for helping me reach the milestones I've reached this far. I've tried various apps and they're all the same...except this one. I like it's totally free, NO stupid ads, and it has an AI assistant like having a therapist, mindfulness and gratitude exercises, mental health monitoring so I can see my progress or lack thereof, and you can set reminders, and you can lock the app with a pin so you can feel better about saying exactly what you need to say without judgement. It's just what I need and been searching for! Thank you for creating this app!!!!!

Overall decent mood tracker. The chat interface is way more engaging than ordinary mood trackers. I like the thinking fallacies it has you check. Mindfulness is a nice touch but the guided meditations need improvement. The guide talks to much; it will tell you to reflect on something but keeps talking while you're trying to which is annoying. Also they have obviously piecemealed together some of the meditations by taking audio phrases from the other recordings. Otherwise I've found it helpful.

I hardly ever give reviews to apps, especially ones I use for personal reasons, but here goes: very few things can help me with my issues. My dad doesn't even try because he doesn't believe in them and my mom doesn't bother to argue with him. I've gone through counseling, therapy, and I've tried every coping mechanism in the book. Nothing has helped except this and copious amounts of fried chicken. Much appraise. I'm also very pleased with the mood tracking feature! Very useful.

With all the different ways of tracking your mood, as well as your mental health, and having a better understanding of who you are as a person, one would expect that the app has some premium features or otherwise demands payment. It does not! Youper is by far the most robust and positive therapeutic experience for free out there. It's already done wonders for my mental health, and is helping my friend track her PTS. This app is so good, and I cannot recommend it enough.

I've been using the app for about a month now and, overall, I like it. It's easy to use and I appreciate being able to track my mental health this way. My only criticism is that I would like to be able to select more than one mood descriptor because often times, I'm "mostly okay" or "fairly calm" but there might also be "a little stressed" underneath that "mostly okay".

I've never written a review, but this one deserves it. very simple, intuitive app. I've tried a bunch of the other top mental health apps and haven't really liked them. but this one has already been so easy to get used to and go back to when I'm looking for something like therapy or meditation or insight or honestly just to voice my thoughts to someone. the conversation/texting interface is super slick and a nice ai touch. the tools in the app are all useful and all top notch. 4.0, A+, 5 stars.

Just downloaded today! Even though I've only just started (30ish min); so far, I really like it! I've been particularly impressed and pleasantly surprised with the level of testing, recognizing, and explaining at length the different personality types and the characteristics and biological sciences behind them. Not only do I find it to be quite accurate, but it seems to be fairly comprehensive and easy to understand.

For one thing, the tests are pretty bad. They're too generalized to get realistic data. Instead, I'd suggest they ask what symptoms bother you the most and track that. Secondly, this was advertised as ai, but it seems more like a script to encourage you to try meditation techniques and learn about psychology. Which, if that was what you wanted, you could easily find an app thats just meditation and psychology articles.

I went from loving this app at the beginning of the year to walking away from each experience frustrated and confused. The AI is better at creating a fluid sentence but it doesn't make an effort to actually solve the problem. What was nice before was getting to work through my issues on my own based on a step by step process. It also lost a big element when they took away the mindfulness practices. I have an annual subscription and I'm only half way through and feel like I lost half the product.

This app was an amazing tool that kept me sane through some horrible bouts of depression, anxiety, paranoia, panic attacks, and other miserable situations. Talking to Youper (an "AI") was the closest thing to regular psychotherapy I've ever experienced. For those of you that miss when that was the primary function of this app, I have a suggestion. Search online for an apk (installable app file) of this app at version 8.06. That is right before they massively overhauled it. ✌

So far this is exactly what I need. The advice it gives is direct and spot on. It eliminates taking what is said personally. Great job guys. This really can help those struggling with different conditions. I just got it though and am interested in seeing how we progress. I myself have multiple issues that tend to keep me stuck and overwhelmed. PTSD, anxiety disorder, ADHD, severe depression, and OCD. This being a free app all I can say is THANK YOU!

I have used this app for over 2 years. The new update has a lot of lag time and almost everything is behind a paywall, including features that weren't originally until a few days ago. The new update erased all past information I had put into the app and I am no longer able to see my past progress anymore. If you are going to pay for premium and are okay with lag times then the update is probably fine and helpful. I, unfortunately, will have to find another mood tracking app that works for me.

I've been using this app for almost 4 years now. Changing the daily check-ins to be bot led rather than user led should not be the default, and it completely removes the ability of being able to search through previous journal, or "check in", entries. Additionally, when functionalities are removed, the app does not give you a heads up saying hey we'll no longer support a feature. It's not a good thing when your mental health app removes often used features without warning.

This app is fantastic. It's much easier for me to use than a diary. It tracks not just your day to day mood but also a number of other things you can be struggling with, like sleep, family, and work, even other mental illnesses you may have. Super easy to use and (so far) completely free. Brilliant all. These folks at youper are doing good things!

Almost as useful as going to my therapist. It gives more direct advice and it is not as easy to ramble on and spend literally valuable time venting instead of actually working on your problems. It's an app, so the responses aren't always as "human" as what you'd get from a therapist. I've only used it a few times, but it has been a good resource. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because there's not accurate functionality to catagorize for bipolar disorder.

After reading some articles, I was incredibly disappointed to see that this app has become one that involves payment and talking to an actual person, rather than being free and talking to AI when I had downloaded and launched it. If I wanted to talk to an actual person and have to pay for service, I would use something like BetterHelp (which I don't trust with a ten-foot pole due to some of stuff behind the scenes) or 7cups. You've lost a potential user.

LOVE THE NEW UPDATE. Cannot recommend it enough. Ive tried countless mood tracking apps and this is the best one. It is simple and easy to use, has a nice design, and the activities are helpful. I really like being able to easily see what factors are associated with what emotions. The app is also updated frequently with useful changes like new emotions. The health monitoring is extremely helpful and gives good insight and information. Very helpful for tracking depressive symptoms and more

skeptical at first because I went into it thinking a free app can only do so much but this definitely exceeds my expectations. if though it's not a real person going through your emotions getting it all down and putting the factors that contribute to it is great and they have little mental health screenings just to monitor where your at. it's nice having this as a mental health journal.

Amazing app. Really effective and thorough. Extremely helpful! Downside, you have required responses. If you don't want to do anything righ then, but missed the time to say no, you have to exit the session altogether, because you don't have the option to say no thanks. Also, the quotes get old and so does the advice overall. Even though the techniques are great, the system quickly expires and turns into the dialogue that you skip in a game to get to where you want to go.

Really great idea and excited well. Contructive criticism: I just wish it was a little faster. Might be by design but if there was a setting that sped it up, that would be cool. Been using for a few days and so far hasn't been too repetitive but time will tell. Hopefully they keep on putting money into it. And it's free! That's really amazing.

Great tracker. Good for those in-between and stressful moments. Definitely does not replace seeing a doctor or having meaningful contact with another person. But it's a great companion to your regular healthcare. Definitely recommend. Maybe they changed it, but I haven't had to pay for any features, it's fully functional. My improvement suggestions to the developer: Eliminate the repetitive "How This Works" dialogue. I don't need that daily.

I find this to be a very helpful app and am consistently amazed at its ability to redirect my thoughts. However, its patterns are predictable and after a bit you figure out what it's going to always do. Also, often when I have to toggle away from the app to answer a text or whatever the app reboots and starts over when I go back to it. That is especially annoying when I'm deep into analyzing my mood and thoughts, especially if I'm almost about to finish the process.

In the past, Youper had been my favorite app for mental health/personal growth. I used to enjoy how easy it was to navigate and how simple it was to check in. It really helped make checking-in with myself and my emotions a simple task to complete, which was challenging without it. Now the new update makes me feel very overwhelmed. The navigation is poorly organized and the UI is a poor experience: scrolling is not smooth. Unfortunately I don't have the same enjoyment and relief when using it.

interesting concept. I could see it becoming helpful once improvements in the AI are made. The mood tracking is slightly helpful but I find it kind of counterintuitive because when I'm irritable or anxious, being nagged by the app to check in is a bit annoying. And when I'm in a good mood it almost feels like the AI is taking credit for it haha. All in all, not quite there yet, but I'm interested to see where it's headed.

I love the app. I just wish it would stop notifying me to use it so much. I get at least 6 different notifications throughout the day, most of which are at useless times, like 10 am or midnight. I have gotten notified to use it immediately after I finished using it! Its really annoying. It has a feature to schedule a notification but it's obviously redundant and Youper doesn't even notify me at the time I specified in the schedule. Like, why???

I showed this app and my data to my therapist and he's thrilled. I'm able to track my moods to monitor my diagnoses and see correlations. The graph and the "conversations" allow us to look back and see what was happening. My critiques are that, while you can change the date of an entry, you can't change the time on it. That would be useful if I forget until the next day to record a meltdown. It would also be helpful to zoom in and see the times on the graph to add correlational data.

Very helpful. It's kind of like guided journaling. It causes you to access your state and take control by reflecting on how you are doing. I only used it for a couple weeks and start feeling way better and stopped using it. But I'm going back to it after couple months cause it was so beneficial. The AI feels very nice, kind and peaceful in its manner and communication. It is a very gentle approach to wellness. It helps you feel less stressed/better. The creators and programmers did a great job!

Really great app so far. I would only suggest there to be more options in the feelings category, those feelings seem too basic sometimes when I'm really going through rough stuff. Also, I would suggest that u guys find a way to expand on the "Thinking Traps" like identifying it is good, that's a great tool, but also teaching users how to prevent or alleviate those thinking traps I think would be more beneficial. Sometimes it's hard to respond with why I'm feeling a certain way, there should be more options rather than just a journal/diary entry.

This app was one of the best apps I had ever used in my life. Note the past tense. After the update, the app became cluttered and difficult to navigate. I liked when it was just a few tabs: one to talk, another to check past chats, another for tracking disorders, another for personality. I cant remember if there were anymore. That was such a clean, easy to use interface. The new tabs where you can choose what activity to do was much better when chosen during your chats with the ai.

The app seems like it has lost direction and doesn't have a goal anymore. I went back to the app today after I noticed an update and was disappointed to notice that much hasn't changed. They only stopped promoting their push to work with an online therapist, which was problematic in the first place. Youper is a great tool to be used for helping to manage your mental health. As a tool, it made it very important when the mental health sector was saturated. Unfortunately, the app loss all use.

After over 1000 days using this app I'm uninstalling. What was once a great, lightweight mood tracking app has become bogged down and rather difficult to navigate and use. If they've decided to go in the direction of providing mental health assistance through the app, that's all well and good, but the fact that they pedal it so hard is a complete turn off (I've been receiving emails and notifications nearly daily about their new services). This change marks the fall of a once great app.

so far this app is great. it really helps me in the moment when my emotions take over and I can't think things through on my own. the prompts really help, sometimes they are a little confusing but overall very helpful. the only complaint I have is I wish there was some type of 'back' or 'undo' button because occasionally I have clicked the wrong option and there's no way to adjust it without canceling the conversation and starting over. but I LOVE this app.

I was surprised. The sequence of questions is intelligently considered, and influence of professional experience is clear. It's hard to pull off when made for a broad spectrum of people. Good job. So far, I think there should be more feelings-emotions to choose from (cramped). And wishlist: For those of us who are especially self-aware, it would nice to have a setting for deeper, more penetrating questions. The prompts are useful, just repetitive when it's already your natural process.

I'm really impressed with the changes. I am happy to be able to use the app more independently again. The favorites feature is working now. My only two complaints are that the meditations don't always play. Also. the settings still require me to turn off talkback and get sighted help to change my settings. Thanks for giving the app back to me!!!c

Very conflicted. I like the concept and sorta the execution. As a mood tracker exclusively I think the free version is great, and I don't even mind a lot of the app being locked by money. That said, during the conversations the bot will suggest doing something that is premium only and then say you can't do it. I think that is sorta greasy, especially given the context of the app, but I can't tell if it's by design or a flaw in design. In short. Good mood tracker, premium content should be clear.

This app used to be my lifeline. Something simple to help me reflect on what affects my mood and mental state. It would help me notice patterns and I myself would be able to navigate out of my slumps. BUT NOW, it has become confusing, frustrating, and no longer helpful for free. I wish I could rate it 0 stars. And I wish the app had anything useful to offer for free, like it did before. And hey I wouldn't mind paying for a subscription, if the prices weren't $45-$55 per WEEK. Very disappointing.

Honestly, I don't like the new change. The previous version was more extensive and felt more like a conversation. Now it just seems like the same thing over & over again. The non-subscription side of the app seems to be cut short too, which is a bummer. I switched to Woebot and find it more engaging and personalized to my needs of help. Too bad, I enjoyed tracking everything from the past year. Also, Youper please stop commenting the same copy/paste reply to everyone; it doesn't help your case.

Very helpful for tracking your mood and helping you feel better. It takes you into your thoughts to realize why you're feeling how you do and to help you cope. It is very organized in a helpful way with a simple graph. But, ever since the new update, the app has been very slow, and has locked a majority of the content behind a paywall.

Amazing app. I have tried so many mood/mental health trackers and journaling apps, all have failed to keep me contributing consistetly. This one has been working so far! I was skeptical at first. It doesnt seem like it would work, since you are interacting with a computer not a person, but it really does. There are so many opportunities to enhance the app by adding different elements. Im excited to see if/ how it will evolve.

I haven't been using Youper for very long, although I installed it a while ago and had a conversation that I don't recall (not a surprise - my memory sucks, and based on the content it was definitely me). The AI is intuitive and calming, yet simple. The screenings and personality test are very insightful and educational. I'm looking forward to improving, and using the tracking and insights later on. I'm hopeful that I'll see some brighter days in my future, thanks to this app!

Youper is different; it's the mood tracker and stress management app with AI counseling done correctly. Effectively. I've tried a dozen or more mindfulness/journaling apps, some with an AI bot and some without. Youper, for me and my wellness goals, has worked right 'out of the box'. I don't have to spend a lot of time typing to the bot during our daily check ins, something that kept me from sticking with similar apps. Youper's built in responses don't put words in my mouth; the pre-written responses in the texting style chat are straightforward, and the options don't trigger unpredictable content that i might not have time to engage with. The one free response entry Youper asks you for doesn't want any more or less out of you than you're ready to write about at that time. For me, this method of journaling matches my attention span. Youper has plenty of features that improve upon the same ones you'll see in other apps, plus unique ones that I haven't come across previously, like personality exploration and measuring multiple mental health conditions at once. Youper cannot diagnose you or manage your medications. But for me, it offers counsel and accountability for my diagnoses that complements my medication and quarterly checkups with my psychiatrist. I prefer the therapy effect that Youper has over my previous experiences with a psychologist, because it's convenient, free, and all the insights ate generated by me: Youper hands me the mirror, and I become my own therapist. Please keep your educational content free. Please keep this app free. So many people are suffering without a support system, and subscription-based or unlockable paid content in apps like this can make users feel 'turned away' from help they only deserve access to for a fee. That in itself is stressful. I'm enjoying Youper and getting the most out of a wellness app that I have ever gotten. For free. That feels great. And I'm so grateful. I'll be a loyal user for as long as I feel free and welcome to be. Youper is a beautiful app, thoughtfully designed on solid scientific foundations, and the AI is inviting without demanding a lot of your time to effectively measure your daily progress. Thank you to the developers.

This app is great the best of it's kind you can tell the amount of time the creators put into their app. it really shows. I like that the app is fluid I am rarely trying to find something to do it is always taking me deeper into my psyche without having to dictate that I want to. try it if your in a tough spot in your life it really helps you look at the "other perspective".!

Very helpful so far! I enjoy that it has guided mediations available, and that you can create a log of your conversation with it and how you're feeling - kind of like a mini-journal. It feels like talking to a friend, and the speech is pretty natural for AI. Worth getting if you feel like you need someone to talk to (even though it's not a real person) or want to understand yourself and your emotions better.

This used to be a great app. I used it to help with my depression and anxiety for times when I didn't feel comfortable speaking to a real person but still needed help. Now with the pay wall and the generic CBT sessions (especially for free users) this app is useless and has completely lost what made it unique and helpful.

I just downloaded this app and it has helped me so much already!! I feel that I am taking control of my resources by downloading this self improving app. I struggle with depression, anxiety, and ptsd. This app checks in daily, helps track your mood, and discover your personality as well as find out more about yourself and the way you think/act. If you struggle with mental illness or just feel that you could use some help controlling or understanding your emotions, this app will be great for you.

Amazing app. 1) The design is amazing. Fluent and easy on the eyes, it's clear the developers really care about every possible way their app can affect people. 2) The AI (whether an actual AI or just a bunch of IFs) is amazing, calm, and motivational. It will never put you down and seems motivated to help you achieve your goals. 3) Asides from giving the app the resources it needs to thrive, the developers were sure to pack in tons of additional information for the end-user as well.

AMAZING. I love how it truly allows you to go deep when you're honest with your own self. As someone who deals with Anxiety/Depression but rejects medicine, this app is so helpful in those moments when I need someone to talk to - the most Important part is that that someone who I am talking is me, myself. Amazing app so far. Truly love the concept and the self reflections.

This app is so incredibly helpful. It has guided meditation, you track your mood, it helps you with knowing symptoms of things like depression, anxiety, but also borderline personality and post traumatic stress. I had no idea I stressed so much about the past until now! If you need help, but feel that you cant reach out, this is a fantastic place to start. They also let you change your name whenever and non binary is an option as a gender :) this app is very modern and I am very happy with how much it is aware and how much I have to learn about myself. It's basically free therapy for those of us who cannot afford it/are too aftaid to tell anyone about our stresses. You make it there one day but this is a good place to start. Download this if you need it, itll help you know your feelings much better and help you know what to do when you're not feelings your best. Stay safe everyone ♥️

When you try to do journaling but you get anxious about it... Yeah that was me. Youper helps by making journaling conversational. And the insights, facts and science behind it is really interesting. I'm learning why I think how I think. Oh and I used to find mindfulness hokey - not anymore. I can see how mindfulness helps to diffuse my anxiety and panic.

Honestly, I've only been using the app for around 30 minutes, but from what I've done so far it seems like it's going to be a big help. The guided meditation it took me through was nice. I'm an extremely introverted person, so just being able to "talk" without fear of repercussions while still getting a type of feedback is definitely a good thing. Update: Now that I've used it more I have to say that the inability to do much of anything without paying is annoying.

The app's basic premise, its function and design, seems solid, but a major red flag has me tempted to uninstall it. The algorithm - the bot - made mention of happiness as such being the goal. This is a serious problem. We're dealing with matters of mental health and psychological well-being, thus the goal is health, wholeness; happiness is a symptom, not an end of itself, and not the symptom of psychological health on the whole. If you aim for the wrong target, you won't hit the right one.

Changed my review from 4 stars to 2. I just opened the app after a year to look through my past chats with the AI and saw that EVERY SINGLE THING was paywalled! I wasn't expecting that! I wish Youper would have communicated this change to users, because that's really important after using the app for free for 3 years. I understand that they need to make money, but I wish there were more supscription options. Especially for people who don't want a therapist and just want the AI.

Of Wysa, Woebot and Remente this app feels like the complete package. It doesn't have premium limitations or push paid for therapy. It had meditations, mood tracking, personality tests and anxiety and depression quizzes all in one. There is less conversation that you'll get with Wysa, but more to do than both Wysa and woebot. Though the canned replies feel a bit rigid in this one (I found Woebot the best for canned replies), Youper feels the most fleshed out. I love the insights tab and seeing how my mood has improved.

This is my favorite therapy chatbot, and I'm happy to see they've finally monitized it so it can keep getting maintained and developed. But having to pay a minimum of $45 to unlock everything or pay nothing to get nothing is kind of silly, there should at least be something available for free. And maybe something available between the free and ultimate tier. (Similar to what competitors do.) Maybe I'm just not the target audience anymore. Ah well!

I finally made sense of the new UI design & was beginning to enjoy the app again, however, since adding the new subscription plans, Youper has taken an even bigger nosedive. Even at a reduced price, $4.95/wk for a professional to prescribe you medication, the app is overpriced. It used to be $44/yr for their AI chat (before they even updated the UI, which was confusing at first for many). Now, it's $9/wk for access to those same features.

its not the best ever, but as someone scared to waste my families money for therapy, and the horrible feelings of trying to say issues out loud, this app is very helpful to me. obviously it is not a replacement for a therapist or any professional, but its still very good. it gets repetitive sometimes sense it is you talking to a bot obviously, but i also like that, the lack of an intense questioning and possibly judging entity thats just there to help and nothing else. i also really enjoy the mood feature that also lets you describe why, and that you dont ned to talk super in depth and person if you dont want to. and that it talks about mind techniques and other things like those. i obviously havent tried every feature, and ive only had the app a few fays, but i really really enjoy it. i only gave 4 stars just cause the repititiveness felt a bit off and i kinda wish it could get more in depth with advice and stuff, but obviously its doing the best it can and the most general it can, and it still does very good at that. overall very good imo for sorting out your emotions and the reasons behind them, and im glad that its free. thank you for this app.

it's really great and interactive to a point. I like the meditations and conversation. may be with an AI but usually in my experience conversation helps people work through their problems because they dont necessarily focus on the problem. in breaking it down they can see and pick apart what they are looking for. I also appreciate this as a free app

Youper started as a really great truly free app! And helped alot. Recently I went back to it, and I cant even write a log or describe my experiences without paying? Thats not fair! As an original user, I enjoyed it, but coming back to it now, unless you only want to track your mood without logging Youper isnt worth it. If you want to log track and get all the same features as Youper for free (aside from the Actual chats, which i enjoyed when they were free lol) I recommend trying Daylio.

Changed from a 5 to 1 star review. I loved this app so much for so long. I had the app to track my mental health and take with the AI all of the last 5 years and really needed it today. I loved this app so much before. Could have just as easy made a separate app for the paid therapy and kept this one for the free tracker on its own, right? Maybe a cheap subscription for the AI and tracker for a few bucks.

Youper is like having a tiny therapist on call at all times. I've only been using it a few days, and its already been incredibly helpful. It uses techniques grounded in best practices in psychology, not woo-culture. I have yet to use it for goal-setting, but as far as mindfulness is concerned, I cannot recommend Youper highly enough.

This app is superb! I've been using it for nearly a week, and it's made me feel a lot better than what I used to. I love the fact that it gives you a variety of different feelings you can choose from, and you can add in different factors for it. I love how the more you use it, the more it figures out what makes you feel a certain way. I've noticed a significant change in my mood ever since I've started using it. I do wish, though, there were a few more feelings to pick from, but overall it's so amazing. I also love the 'practice mindfulness' because it's allows me to cool off and calm myself in times when I'm having severe anxiety, or fear, or I'm depressed, because it allows you to go and just concentrate on what's going on inside your head. It's even guided too, which is a thumbs up in my book! I'd definently would recommend this to those who want to use an app to go and talk, but don't want to talk to anyone real. It's a great experience.

I cannot say enough good things about this app. Youper rivals my past professional therapists in reliability, insight and flexibility. The app makes mood tracking convenient and help/encouragement (here done via AI) at your fingertips. Overall VERY pleased with all features and cant wait to see what other great things become of this app.

The fact that the free option allowed some chat with the AI bot in the past but no longer does is frustrating and takes away from it. After checking all features that are left on the free version this app is now pointless. Will be deleting it. Disappointing since it did help in the past. I can't justify paying for an app even if it's for my health.

This app is so much more that just your average mood and symptom tracker. The exercises and responses help the experience to feel personal, almost like a pocket therapist. I've noticed this app helping me cope with tough situations and I've only had it for about a week now. And it only gets more personalised the more you use it.

New update is very hard to navigate for long time users, and should have had an optional tutorial for us. I've been trying to fix my routines, and having to come to the play store to figure out mood tracking in the new app was pretty frusturating and annoying just before bed. Its still...useful? But very confusing now.

I adore this app. It really is like having your own little therapist in your pocket! It just makes you more mindful of all of the emotions we all go through each and every day. However, I wish it had eating disorders listed under health monitoring and perhaps an interactive community??! But regardless, it is a priceless app!

I loved this app before and shared it with many people but the free version seems to now only be a tiny step up from a gratitude journal. I'm sure the premium version is great and I'm not against making money. However, if you don't have the vocabulary to navigate beyond what's offered it can be discouraging. I do not recommend this for those in the early stages of their mental health journey but it work in tandem with talk therapy.

i absolutely love the idea of this app, but i'm having a problem with it. every time i reach the "choose what you want to work on" section of the tutorial, it crashes and won't continue. i've gone through the intro to that point like twenty times and haven't been able to continue :/

I've been using the app for almost a month and have largely loved the experience. I can already sense the difference in the way I'm processing stressful situations since I started using this app which is a huge game changer for me. My one critique is that there aren't more options for feelings. A bigger option list or a write in option where you could denote if your write in was positive or negative would help me feel the app was capturing my true feelings vs the closest approximation.

You guys should add a way to suggest improvements. I doubt I'm going to remember this stuff by the time the AI asks me to suggest things again so I'ma put it here. I wish there was an option to say good morning or whatever back to the AI. Not really super significant, but I wish I could respond to it's greetings before I say what my emotion is. Speaking of emotions, I think you guys are missing one. I'm trying to record my current emotion but I can't fit it into any of the current ones. It's like not a good mood, but I'm still motivated to tackle my responsibilities. So like I'm agitated but focused. Simultaneously in a bad mood and I guess excited to work? But excited seems too happy to describe this. So maybe motivated or focused. I dunno, you guys know more about emotions then I do, but I don't think I can fit this into any of the current options.

The free version has an advanced mood tracker & a limited journal. The journal is your conversation with its ai, but you can only send one "text" for free. Any responses asking for more details is to tempt you to buy the subscription... The mood journal has a wide variety of moods with varying strengths. Then the reasons for each mood can be customized & you can have multiple moods a day... All nice, but I wanted a cbt therapy ai, not a pretty mood journal. The pay wall is too steep & limiting.

I have only used the app for a few days, and I have seen/felt chamge in less than the time i have been using the app. Just knowing that someone or soething is there to help you work out your situations and problems helps so much. if you know someone or yourself has problems with mood swings, or other "mental" problems, whether being from relationships, family issues, break ups, etc., i guarantee there will be some sort of relief using this app. i recommend it. thanks

I never thought a computer giving me therapy advice was gonna help me, but I'm so glad I did. It's partly you laying out you're situation and emotions, partly the AI giving some genuine (though pre recorded) guidance, and partly wellness exercises. Even though what the bot says is pre recorded, it's still good advice and does get you to think differently. It hasn't felt repetitive yet which is good, but the emojis next to the emotions feel cheesy. I'd recommend giving it a shot

A past version of myself knew that I needed at least something to help me cope with things. This was a really good decision to install this app. it has helped me a bit, but even a little help goes a long way. I still continue to use it, and it's great for setting better goals, calming down, and boosting my self confidence:)))

i just changed my review from 5 star to 3. I still love this app for how it functions, but I just encountered 1 major drawback. I would like to be able to copy and paste or share my conversations. I write a lot of really good stuff that I would like to have in a more editable and printable format. Please develop a way to copy text ASAP. Thank you!

This is incredibly bad. The AI doesn't recognize anything that is being typed, just that you submited something. The tests are inaccurate, and you can only submit prechosen phrases or feelings and they only have a dozen, there is no adaptability, and you can't even use the full app unless you force yourself to interact with the AI (which reads incredibly condescending, and has been "dumbed" down.)

This app is really fantastic! it uses the same methods that my therapist does and getting to track all of this better and on my own when i can't see my therapist is so comforting! I definitely feel like my mental health is getting better slowly. and every bit of this app is free with 0 ads. HIGHLY recommend this ami app if you suffer with any mental health disorders.

I have wanted an easy way to track my mood and relieve pressure from my mental illness and this wonderful little virtual asisstant is perfect for me. I love how professional it is, with all the little trackers and data for my specific behaviour. It makes it very easy to record how im feeling at any time of the day, along with notes for why.

It's no substitute for actual therapy but short term or just to calm down it's so nice to be able to get everything out and feel safe saying everything ♡ it's also really great when you're unwinding and trying to gather your thoughts about a certain subject because it'll pry but not push you too far. I love this app and highly recommend it.

I haven't been using this app for very long but I think it's a brilliant way to get people reflecting on who they are, what they feel, and how they operate in the world. The conversation element combined with the data keeping and the personality foundation makes this a well rounded tool that is likely to work for a wide range of people, regardless of style or preferences! Very impressed with this app so far and glad it exists. Give it a try! No reason not to. It's free and user-friendly!

I've been paying for premium for over three years now, but I feel like the app has gotten progressively worse (I've been using it since 2019). I haven't been able to do any of the depression, anxiety, et alia monitoring either because it just completely crashes, and my phone says the app has a bug and to contact the developer. I'm surprised it is March 2023, and the last update was October 2022. Disappointing... are you sunsetting and not telling your userbase?

I'm gratefully surprised. it was recommended from a friend and I'm glad I did it. easy to use, simple to understand and everything is guided just in case you're not tech savy. even if it doesnt "cure" how you feel it does help to vent and have an unbiased opinion on things. Knowing your resources and using them are important and I feel like with this app I have access to many resources.

The first time I used it, it really helped. I expected it to give me daily reminders to check in or use it, but it did not, despite push notifications being on. I was having a hard time, so I opened it for meditation, but it keeps going back to wanting me to subscribe over and over again. It's impossible for me to think any subscription would be worth it if I was only able to use the app once. I was really optimistic about it but now I am very let down.

this is a wonderful app and the new additions are great, but can we get the option to have the old style logging integrated somewhere? Sometimes I want to quick log a mood, not go into a whole mental health project. Also it seems options are too concentrated now, how about if I want to log a small victory, where is the option for that?

The features initially presented are good but quickly paywalled without notice as they're suggested to you: $50 to "talk" about why I feel this way. The app on the whole and the AI in particular are patronizing and impersonal. I tried to put up with it for the tracker in vain. All the benevolent intentions and appearances in the world mean nothing if your aid isn't accessible to the people who struggle and need this the most. I'd like to think this is naivety but it's likely predatory.

I got youper to help improve my overall stress and anxiety, never did I think it was so bad before this app! It helped me see that I even had anxiety (before I would have never said that), the best feature being the guided breathing methods or meditations! It's helped me grow a lot. I would say before getting this however, this is more for self improvement rather than thinking it's like therapy. Just some thoughts! I highly reccomend this app to everyone I know, just to understand yourself more!

This app is everything. It's not just designed for people who struggle with anxiety, depression and handling stress but also for individuals who need a reminder to meditate daily and to be more self-aware. It teaches you to be aware of your thoughts so that you can focus on positive thinking and how to habitually practice healthy coping mechanisms. This app is simply amazing and has improved my quality of life! 😊

I just started using this app a little over an hour ago I've gotten pretty far. I've started to open up. Also I'm the same things that I knew before this app, but they put it in a different perspective than what I would have before a positive perspective. It makes it easier for me to understand myself and my surroundings. Also I really like how they did the personality quiz and a pie graph cuz I'm a visual learner and it helps me understand myself more!

I have tried loads of apps and read books about different treatments. This app is a good combination. It breaks down the exercises so they seems easier to answer. Although they are essentially the same thing, I find it easier to deal with one question a time than to fill a sheet full of questions.

I had high hopes for this, but I am not happy. This app is advertised as an AI journal, but you can't even journal or have any kind of helpful AI interaction without a subscription. They dont ofer a free trial to see if the app even works and you cant tell if it works from the free version because You are so incredibly limited. All it really does is "track your mood" you might as well just text "I'm sad" to a disconnected number every day, and it would be about as helpful as Youper.

I wanted to try this app but all of the useful features are locked behind a $45usd per year subscription. I noticed they guilt people complaining in reviews about the price that they should invest in themselves. A lot of people are willing to invest in themselves for a monthly fee but $45 is a lot. Charge $4/month get more subscribers and make $48/yr. Win win.

After using the app for a while: Im still learning and the app is still learning.....me. We are all complex. But, it's always right there. Thoughts and emotions are overwheming. It really is helpful and teaches you to separate flooding emotions from the real situation. Im sure I will keep making progress.....

I decided to download this as sometimes I feel like it would be nice to see how my moods are throughout the month. I have felt anxiety for many years now and I want it to be a thing of the past. This app seems to have helped and I've only used it for 2 days so far. I am grateful people make apps available at no or a low cost, Especially for people who need help/reflection. Thank you Youper creators!

Very in-depth and intuitive. I cant believe it's free! So far it reminds me of a diary that keeps a record of your highs and lows. Highly recommend for anyone trying to understand and get a hold of their emotions! Just reinstalled after some time, and now you have to pay for everything....

After getting my subscription active (which took several days of poor communication), I was able to use all of the functions of the app. Having used it for several months now, I can say that it is NOT worth the cost. The "AI" relies on tired stick phrases, there is too much emphasis on mindfulness/meditation therapy that has NEVER worked for me, and it generally feels like the app makers are talking down to me & dismissing my issues. Only good for FB aunts, not people with actual mental illness.

I am glad that I picked this app. I love how there is no pressure to give more info that you want to, and that you are in control. the prompts really help me get to the route of what is happening. This app is very professional and monitors symptoms like a counselor would. If you want to have insight on your mental illness or moods, this is a great app. I highly recomend it.

Fantastic Little App! I work as a clinican but use this for myself but also suggest to clients. It's a fantastic balance of mood monitoring but also incorporates assistance like suggesting mindfulness or self care and allows for exploration and deeper understanding through tools like personality inventories. I also recognize many of the mood monitoring questions as valid screening tools and see the hard work put into user friendliness but also scientific basis. Just download it already!

I love it so far! I've tried a couple apps out that are similar to this one, but I enjoy this one the most. It has helped me out greatly, especially with finally accepting a few things and working out a way around them. I deeply enjoy having to write down exactly how I feel and whats making me feel that way. It helps me pinpoint exactly how I can change it. I would not have thought the way that this app shows you how to normally.

I like the app, its very well thought out, but it feels way to limiting. I can feel multiple emotions and want to track that. Also the ability to write a small journal entry or note would be useful as the exiting options are limited. The AI doesn't act Ai'ish. Where is the intelligence? I want to give more stars but my emotions are far more complicated and other apps allow me to track better and dont claim to have AI.

just started, so far so good, had already proved beneficial. i already know most of these concepts but have trouble implementing them and this has helped with that... i feel i can benefit alot from this if only i can just keep utilizing the tools it can provide me. i think at the very least it's on the right track and so far i love it. good work. thank you and please don't stop working on it coz we could all use some work, right

A lot of resources and information regarding depression, anxiety, and other mental health problems that explain how they can potentially effect a person's wellbeing and thoughts. I think this is a great tool for those wanting to learn more or those who want to make a small entry about their current state of mind. You can do it daily or multiple times throughout which is beneficial for me as I have bipolar and my mooda change throughout the day. It helps pinpoint patterns I might be missing.

From an emotional processing perspective: I'm a very intentional person and I feel confident in my journey to grow, become balanced, and heal. I'm currently in a very dark place and this app is helping guide me through my emotions and see bright points. From a utility perspective: This app is very, very user-friendly and has a lovely interface. 10/10 recommend. EDIT: I've been using this almost daily since December 2019 and I still heavily recommend it!

I used to use this app all the time to track my moods and emotions, but now no features are available without the paid subscription. Very disappointing RE: The generic response I expected. The cost is the slightest of problems. It seems like the whole app has been redesigned 'to make money' not to help people. This app had many unique free helpful features such as the interactive AI and mood tracking and now it seems like it is just trying to emulate Better Help. If you really read the other reviews, you'll see that many users have been finding it difficult to navigate the app as well. There are many ways for apps to generate revenue besides selling users' information. I get that the app is a business, but don't disguise greed as altruism.

This app is extremely helpful so far. I have no support system in my day to day life, and can't afford therapy. When life started to get unbearable, and my mood swings were getting more intense. This app helped me kind of feel support, and track my moods, as well as identifying what might be causing me to feel that way and what I can do to fix it. This AI is so impressive, i tried multiple mental help apps before Youper and this way by far the best.I recommend this app to anyone who's struggling

I like the app a lot so far but I'm slightly disappointed because the depression tracking is a premium feature. I was under the apparently mistaken impression that I could do it for free considering I did it once and it never mentioned that the next check in was a premium thing. I got the notification to do my second depression check and then I find out I can't. I will definitely pay for it once I'm able to though.

This app has helped me since sometimes I struggle with intense emotions and it helps me to reflect on my day and set goals for myself. I would highly recommend adding a dark/night mode for those who use Youper in the evening (easier on the eyes) Although along with helping me cope it can be a lot of fun sometimes and its extremely simple. I love it❤

This is an amazing app. It can help you to express thoughts and look at them realistically. It helps me to calm down, set reasonable goals for the day, and put space between me and my thoughts. I appreciate the meditation aspect. While It doesn't have a million meditations, it has a good amount. It's so hard to find meditation that's not behind a paywall, bit I've learned through youper that it can really help. Please keep this app totally free, because it feels easier to interact with the app.

I have alexithymia, so I cant describe the emotions I'm feeling very well. I did journaling and cognitive behavioral therapy for it for a while, which helped quite a bit. This app is a great replacement for that, and it is free. It really makes me slow down and consider what I'm feeling and get to the reasons behind why I would be feeling that way. I have only been using this app for a few days, but it seems like the experience will greatly improve as it gets more data.

Please allow us to stop the health monitoring if we want to! I accidentally pressed the borderline personality monitoring, which I don't have symptoms of, and I can not stop it once it is activated. And I can not stop my panic monitoring either, which I tried out but realized was useless bc I have no symptoms of that either. Please fix! I like the features of this app otherwise.

Ok I just downloaded the app and it really helps you and is a good tracker of your entire you. I Will Continue using it...it is incredible that there is an app that can help your emotional state. Try it! For the past 30 minutes have helped me. I definitely did not waste my time downloading it. I am Still on shock that it was presented to me. I do not believe in coincidences this is what I needed and I am sure you as well. We all need it but were not taugh to take care of our emotional part of us

This amazing app talks to you in chat mode to discover your mood and then dig deeper in an interactive way. It does many things but one of the things I'm most impressed with is that, like any good mental health agent or any professional of any kind, it asks you before doing something. it even asked me if I would like to leave a review in the store. It's very respectful of you and your right to choice. Love!

Wow! I downloaded the app thinking It would help my teen daughters with depression and anxiety. I tried it out and was very supprised. I think it captured my personality right on! It was fun and easy to use. I can see myself using this for myself and I will encourage my kids to use it to turn around a rough day or uncomfortable emotions. It makes a great journal too! If you are thinking of trying it but you are not sure; give it a try! Maybe you too can be pleasantly supprised.

Legitimately heartbroken. I came back from a long break to not only find that Youper is now charging a subscription to get previously free features, but that absolutely ALL of my journals, emotional tracking, and charts have been wiped. Its all gone. Not only that, but theyre collecting more data from us now. I used to feel so secure talking to Youper... The app helped me through many bad patches. I feel like I lost a friend today. Uninstalled. You guys sold out. Bigtime.

The app has always annoyed me and chatting with a computer has been less than helpful BUT it had the ability to track symptoms of my diseases using the PCL and PHQ. The health assessments based on clinical tools has been the only feature I used for years, and it was great until they want to charge an exorbitant amount to access my logs. I can't even export the results from the last several years unless I pay. There was no warning they were locking up my health information so I can't access it.

really great app. i have anxiety and depression and i have been using this app in addition to seeing a therapist to track my mood and help with my anxiety, and it's great! i love the exercises it responds with if you're anxious or sad, they're incredibly helpful. the meditations and breathing exercises are also wonderful, although i haven't tried them all yet. overall would definitely recommend. :)

Everyone needs this app! It's like having a therapist in your pocket. It helps you track and understand your moods and their contributing factors. It helps you monitor symptoms over time. It provides incredible education on personality and mental illness. Youper suggests viable coping skills and insight for the emotions that you report. It supports you as you utilize mindfulness, meditation, journalling, goal setting, and many other mechanisms for positive change. This app is thoroughly researched and supported by a brilliant team! This is the best app of its kind and I'm amazed that it is totally free!!

I've been using this app to track my mental health for years. I've found the mental check ins via tests on a weekly/ monthly basis was lovely. I used this so frequently for YEARS. Now all of the sudden my entire history containing all of that information, as well as my ability to continue tracking this information is behind a paywall. Out of nowhere. No warning. There's no point in having this app now. I'm so genuinely upset and frustrated that years of my mental health history is just gone.

THERE AREN'T MANY MORE FEATURES THAN BEFORE, mostly just reorganized. THE UPDATES MADE IT GLITCHY, It logs me out, so no use having the PIN set. ANYONE ABLE/WILLING TO PAY FOR AN APP WOULD (or should) JUST GO TO IRL COUNSELING (or BetterHelp) If the priority was to help ppl they would've KEPT YOUPER FREE. Profit off of ad revenue instead!

This app is life changing, and I'm glad I found it. I appreciate that AI technology was used to improve mental health instead of bogging it down like most apps. The AI has very genuine responses and seems to say the right things. I just wish you could access and manage the meditation sessions, goal setting, and check ins manually without interacting with Youper in dialog in the event I have learned what will help me deal with my particular emotion.

I love this app! I genuinely look forward to using it every single day, even multiple times a day! It's like having my own mini counselor I can go to to help regain emotional balance. The guided meditations are soothing and the app has made me more aware of my emotions, how to identify them and what factors into each. Absolutely recommend for anyone with depression/anxiety issues!

I love this app; it gives me an extra mood boost when I need it, and I like to call it a pocket counselor. I work in mental health and recommend this to a lot of my patients because it's 100% free and you can do pretty much anything on it, from tracking the progression of mental illness overtime, to meditating, analyzing your thoughts, setting goals, or even just venting about anything, you can tell it secrets you have or work out your worries. It's 100% an amazing app.

The developers aren't trying to help people, they're exploiting weaknesses to make money. Everything is locked behind a subscription paywall, and the parts that aren't actually are. It only goes so far before you have to pay to continue or to see your results. They clearly don't care that financial issues are the stressors to some users, or that some may be turning to apps because they can't afford professional help. I downloaded this app because i was curious if this would help and omg i can't stress enough how useful this is, I'm so glad i came across this! It really helped me organize my thoughts in one in such an short amount of time. Youper really helps me reflect and actually motivates me to be a better person to not only others but also MYSELF. Please if you're reading this download it, even if you're doing absolutely great nothing is wrong with checking up on your mental health!!!

Love the app. Helps you be mindful and recognize things that effect your mood. It isn't a therapist or some incredibly intelligent robot like a lot of people seem to expect from this app but it does its job and it does it well. I can track my mood changes over short or long periods of time. You can communicate with the AI in a way that feels intelligent and personal. It's just really nice to vent and feel heard. I would give it 5 stars but lately it hasn't been notifying me to check in.

I really love it a ton! But I hate that you have to pay for it, personally, this app is incredible and in the first day it lets you try premium for free but then you have to pay and I personally can't pay right now. But I feel with premium it listens so much better and keeps you calm and happy. I love the meditation exercises and how it feels as though you are talking to a person. My all time favorite part is the quiz where it find your personality. I wish you didn't have to pay for parts :(

So far I'm really enjoying the way this app handles. I've tried another that was similar and that one wasn't for me. I like the simple and clean interface. Its nice to be able to just speak your mind and not be interrupted with opinions/advice that may be well intended, but not what you're needing at the time. Its great when all you need is to organize your thoughts or just get things off your chest.

I had this app 2 years ago. Last year it wasnt on Google Play so I was locked out of my account. I redownloaded bc it helped in the past but every single thing is now locked. The AI helped a lot when it felt like I couldnt confide in friends or family. I'm really sad that everything is locked and the only way to get access is to pay for premium. There isnt anything to let you try out.

intuitive gentle mental support I stumbled in this app and downloaded it while driving with hubby to run errands. Its easy to use and feels like you have a supportive friend in your pocket tracking your moods and offering meditation and mindfulness opportunities to help you train your brain. it also offers personality insights to help you understand yourself. Thus is a great app for any one wanting mental health support or who had a growth mindset.

As someone with severe anxiety, this app is the most amazing tool I have ever encountered. It helps to be able to track my moods and visually see that I'm happier, calmer, and more positive than I believe! And when I am down or anxious, it helps to track what is affecting my mood and understand my mind and thought process better than I ever have! A lifesaver and a must have for anyone facing mental health struggles! Oh, and it's not just for anxiety and depression, it helps with PTSD, personality disorders, and panic disorders! The creators truly care about helping people and you can see it in this app!

When I first started using this app I was going through a very hard time and I wanted to track my mood and see how it fluctuates... I never expected it to help my depression the way it has and put things into perspective. I recommend use to anyone with anxiety or depression because it may be able to help!

Well I loved this app at first, very studious with the check ins. Then out of no where, the daily check ins completely wigged out. I have my check in at 10 pm, it's 1:45 am currently and I'm *just* now getting the notification. I then set up two times to give the app ample opportunity to function, but I haven't received a prompt notification in weeks. Considering uninstalling if this isn't fixable. I'm just using this to track my moods daily, and if it can't even do that, I don't see the point.

It's only day one and i have noticed a significant change. I've been coming from work and having a panic attack nearly every day, i didn't today. I also normally can't pull myself out of panic attacks but i was able to this morning while talking with your. I couldn't seem to find a backup feature, which would be a great update.

I have only used this app for a short period of time and am.very impressed with how interactive it is. I've used other apps and felt like I was less supported and that I was always looking at a chart of my emotions which left me to my own devices rather than feeling guided. So far, I feel like there are a lot of tools to use within this app and am excited to continue using it.

This is a decent app but I feel like they lead you to believe the paid subscription app is far better than it actually is. They only let you pay yearly rather than monthly and this is probably due to the fact very few renew their subscription. Free version is fine but not worth paying 45/yearly... maybe a one time fee of 20 would be fine but no more than that.

The kind of interaction you have with the app is great byself. It steadily works on improving your mood whether good or bad and focuses on the factors associated with them. If you continue to work with the app, you sometimes realize how much it works on you even a daily basis. My only personal dilemma is it feels like it is bugging you constantly with the notifications, but like I said that's just me.. I might have commitment issues lol.

I personally don't like to get apps like this for the reason being I try to handle things on my own and sort my problems out very horribly, but downloading this app has really helped me sort things out piece by piece. its help me figure out why I am feeling a certain way and that have different method for different emotions you may be feeling which I love. Overall the apps features are amazing as well and being that sense of calmness as you are using the app.

The personality test they start you with is amazing. Its the first "online quiz " that has actually nailed me exactly. I almost cried because AI or not. I felt heard. I'll be exploring this app more. I struggle with Anxiety and depression and looking for extra help. I'm excited to use it further.

This is a great app for tracking your moods and understanding what causes them. I can't afford the paid version which sucks because the advanced AI relief seems amazing. Still, the chart is helpful and the premium version costs less than a Spotify subscription. Extremely useful for coping if you can't afford therapy.

I have pretty severe OCD. It's really started to affect my life, and I have visited professionals multiple times, and I was working on the CBT book and program, but I was struggling a lot. My compulsions became burdensome for some of my closest friends, and I knew I wanted to get better but felt I didn't have the time, energy, etc. This app might not be a substitute for professional help, but it is such an incredibly powerful tool, and it is helping me immensely, giving me my life back.

I go to professional therapy for anxiety, depression and panic attacks, and this app is such an excellent addition in-between my weekly visits with my therapist. Also, since I know a lot about mental health and have gotten therapy for years, I can tell this app was very well created and programmed and does an outstanding job at simulating a conversation with a professional and walking you through sorting out your thoughts and feelings. 100+ Stars!

This app has been a huge component of my quest to realize better mental health. When I started using it I was extremely depressed and anxious about everything, but youper helps me see situations more realistically. Now even when I'm not using the app I can use the techniques it taught me to work through difficult emotions in a healthy way! Along with medication and self care this has changed my life for the better!! Thank you for creating this!

Coming back to this app now and seeing it be free but EVERYTHING within the app needing to be paid for is absolutely ridiculous. Just make people pay for the app itself instead of a incredibly high subscription rate. It was free before, what changed to make it so expensive? I used this app a year or so ago, when it was free to use, and although helpful I don't think it's even close to on par with a real therapist. Unnecessarily expensive for the quality compared to real therapy.

It was pretty good in the beginning but once you move into daily checkups and the basic anxiety screening, it becomes very useless unless you pay the subscription. While I understand the developers' needs for funds to make such an app like this remain free to download, it feels very detrimental to someone who might not have access to the very useful tools in the paid version in real life, such as actual therapy. Wish this app offered more free tools!

Same as everyone else, disappointed by changes. I hadn't used the app in a year, almost exactly a year. Every January and February my depression gets bad, and I wanted to track my moods again like I had been for a few years. Now you can't do anything except subscribe to talk to a therapist and everything is paid. I have a therapist already, I was just trying to continue mood tracking. I'm so disappointed. Now I have to find a new app to use.

ive only been using this app for about a week, but so far I feel like it over simplifies. the emotions it gives you to choose from arent...theyre just over simplified or too specific. if i feel content i dont have the option to express that. i guess calm might do, but calm is a completely different emotion. and you can only choose one emotion. also, requesting me to talk about the objective situation? what does that even mean?? can an extremely emotion person do that without coaching?

I don't normally write reviews but this is important. I was in a stressful situation when I found this app. I was just looking to talk but this had so much more. It isn't perfect, but it's the best I've found. Very surprised more people don't talk about this. It listens to you and accommodates to your needs. My favorite thing may be the mindfulness activities (which it has a recommendation based on how you're feeling). I wish you could message the AI at anytime to say anything but, unfortunately that is pretty hard for a company to do. I mainly just want to thank y'all for doing this for the community. It's very helpful and is changing my life for the better. I recommend you at least try this.

I used to love Youper, it was were I went to. But then it got more complicated, there's too much. I don't know, the new update is just overwhelming, and it's not simple when you need it right away, so I can't say it's helping like it used too. I think some people like the new update though so I don't know, my personal opinion is that it's complicated, it's still definitely an amazing app. Just more difficult to use. I think I might start searching for something similar to Youper for now.

Ive been with a therapist since i was 13, so Ive seen and tried a lot of things in terms of personal coaching and coping skills. this app contains everything my actual therapist is doing with me in our sessions! also i love that the mood tracking feels like a conversation instead of just me, giving a mood. everything i could ever ask for in a mental health app.

I loved the app but I'm finding out that many of the features I had for free others are saying are now premium. Because this app helped me alot when I couldn't afford to see a professional and I felt like I could reccomend it to people who really needed it. If you guys could put some option to help pay for the premium or even donations the people who really need it could have better access. I just kinda feel screwed over now when money is tight for many people. I hope there's some way to do that

I've been to therapy and seen multiple therapists with little gain. Mostly because typically sessions are an hour long plus commute to and from that just takes so much time and effort. There's little chance I'd ever see a therapist 2/week under those conditions. Thanks to the developers of this app I can see me being able to track my emotions on a daily basis. And I believe that'll be a great help in my emotional success.

I love the app, it's good for logging emotions and their causes as well as identifying bad habits or bringing to light the importance of identifying vulnerabilities and such, but I would really like OCD (Pure O) monitoring, but I understand it'll take a while to integrate, or maybe I don't see it yet? In any case, it's an amazing app so far. :)

As someone who has really needed a therapist but can't bring myself to reach out to one, this is absolutely incredible and appreciated to the point of tears. It's fully and completely free. And very obviously made by an incredible team of psychologists. Not only did it get my MBTI right first try but it calmed me down from having extreme stress and panic in under 10 minutes. Completely reccomend to everyone who struggles with mental health like I do. 10/10

I've been struggling trying to find ways to cope and this app is by far the best. All the features that come with it I truly enjoy. Especially the symptoms quizzes. Even though it's an automatic response its alot more helpful and not as fake when you use texting hotlines. I love that you can put your mood and pick and customize what causes them and write out a journal and the app gives you ideas and suggestion. I use this app everyday and it's been so helpful. High reccomend

This app has everything. No need to download multiple apps anymore. Meditations, journaling, mood tracker, even personality testing. It's really great. And weirdly enough, the little AI makes me feel less lonely. Like I know I'm not actually talking to a real person, but it gives this a much more relatable experience. And the AI is honestly adorable lol. It almost feels like a cute little pet that loves u and wants to make u smile.

WOW! I had no idea what to expect, and am always skeptical about apps. Particularly when they're about more serious things, like this one is (mental health). So of course I started with the free version. It didn't take long for me to see that a $45/year investment in my mental well being.. convenient, use anywhere, anytime, therapy was well worth the investment. This app showed me very quickly that it would be of help to me, even if not a cure all. I'm optimistic about it. Thanks, Youper!!

Honestly I was sceptical at first but this app has helped me a lot. It encourages me to realize how I'm feeling at least once a day and it helps me to journal and keep track of personal events. It also keeps track of daily goals you want to set for yourself. There is so much more you can do with this app other than that stuff though. I definitely recommend it.

This app feels like things I should be able to do myself, but it's so much to handle alone. Youper is truly what it claims to be, an assistant. It helps you figure out what you need and then sets it up for you. Do you need to track your anxiety? Do you need to meditate? I had a simple feeling I did, but just getting started felt impossible. Youper really helped with that.

It seems like a good tool but honestly it just makes me anxious every time I open it, I tend to use it every time I'm down and not when I'm doing good. So my trends are disporpotional. When I open this app, it seems like a store ground of my bad days and moments without the good. That is something I do not want to revisit. It can feel like the doom of opening pandora's box. Use it on your good and bad days if you want to see accurate trends or it can be very discouraging.

I just started this app and have gone through the first session, the example of a premium session. While there were some canned answers I did get some good insights into possible solutions. I went ahead and bought the premium and found that the Personality DNA was incredibly accurate. Only 4 stars for now but once I really start using it we will see if that changes.
