For being an AI its pretty useful. Its not so much for direct hands on and isnt a substitute for a therapist but better as a self help to navigate frequent turbulent emotions. Its a good mindfullness tool if uses properly. I would definitely recommend giving it a try for those who are semi-independent. You should also add a system to collect statistics on common thought traps.

This has to be one of the best apps for managing symptoms of mental health diagnosis. This isn't just about doing meditation and hum your problems away, it's facing your symptoms and talking to yourself about it. It's difficult at times because you really do have to face some of the emotions, but that's the point of the app. This app is fantastic. It has exceeded my expectations.

This used to be a wonderful app that helped me so much. I am coming back to it seeing a money hungry monster. I hate what this app has become like I see many others have. It's not about helping anyone anymore. The free AI was all we needed that offered tools for us to get better. Now it requires all of this set up and subscription?? Ridiculous I have now changed my 5 star to a 1.

This does accually help me alot more than I thought it would. I've only had it for a few days and Whenever I feel stressed I turn to this. I seem to keep up with it alot more often then a journal and I really appreciate that it'll check up on you as well. Some things are kinda repetitive but I found that so is therapy and remembering to take meds every day sooo... But I really like it and I haven't even explored everything on it.

So far the app is fantastic and very easy to use. It's nice to have an interactive way to log anything your worried or happy about. There's guidance on focusing on the positive and learning to let go of the heavy things bogging you down even if it's only for a temporary moment (you'll get better as you practice!). I hope this app helps others as much as it's helping me.

I am also a member of "I used to love this app, but now..." I can't even login now without having to answer a thousand personal questions that apparently will be used to help you find a counselor/therapist for a weekly fee. I don't need a counselor or therapist, I need an app to help me in between my appointments with my already-established Healthcare team. Huge disappointment to have seen this app shifted in the way that it has. It was really helpful the way that it was. Boo.

Just started using it today, but I really like the format and features so far. My current feedback is just to include "Self Employed" in the employment status part of the setup, it's a very important distinction in what kinds of stress are likely present that are not common to other categories. Keep up the good work, guys and gals!

This app is awesome. Only been using it for a couple of dats but ut has helped calm me and be more focused and to set my goals and keep them present and in focus. I would recommend thus app to anyone struggling or anyone who just feels as though they need an emotional coach or emotional focus!!! Great app guys. I hope to see more from thus developer!!!

great app. so far I'm learning so much about the deeper things I've hidden or failed to reflect on about myself. it helps organize my thoughts and stay on track. the AI also speaks in a very natural manner, as if talking to a friend who actually listens and doesn't rush to insert their opinion on something. love this app.

The free version is great but the premium is amazing! For only a price of 1-2 therapist visits you can learn to track your emotions and feelings and how to improve them or how to keep them going. You get to track your good feelings and you can see them later. Or track bad ones and you'll be coached into improving that mood/feeling.

so far so good, made an account and logged in and received good info and haven't been asked for payment info at all yet, this is the third or fourth app like this I tried and the other 3 previous to this one didn't let you get very far without signing up for a free trial and subsequent paid subscription. I was able to complete a personality quiz and learn some things about myself. love it.

Also a former user of the app who reinstalled to be met with disappointment. Wasn't the entire idea of youper to help you identify thinking tracks and moods yourself? I wish I could at least access my old journal entries but upon signing back in, you can't really do anything until you select a payment plan.

This app really helps me to understand my emotions and what makes me feel a certain way. I've been able to make so much mental progress, and the meditation videos are amazing. I really do recommend this app to anyone with anxiety or depression, and I hope you can get the same great expierence with the app that I did.

I've been using Youper for about 3 months now, and it's significantly reduced my anxiety and allowed me to keep better track of my emotions. I feel in control for the first time in a long time, and Youper's guided meditation and personalized responses seem to always fit what I need in the moment. A lovely app, great for feeling better

I am still in the early stages of use, however, thus far I really appreciate the app. Some time ago, when I was suicidal, I could not get through to any hot lines, so I turned to the internet and found this app. It has helped tremendously for me to track and record my moods and better understand what is going on in my mind. I recommend for anyone who needs extra support like this in their lives right now.

Editing my review: it used to be a great app where it wanted to help people for free. I often recommended in many Neurodivergent groups for people who couldn't afford therapy. I was feeling blue and opened the app recently. I'm shocked that it's some weird pay service thing. It used to be an AI cbt app with mental health monitoring and meditations. I would provide constant feedback to help the app grow. It's trash. Don't use it.

This app has promise and is generally impressive, but I have two issues. First, some answers the user can give are limited to positive responses when you aren't feeling that way. It also uses the PHQ-9 for monitoring depression, which is not what it was created or clinically tested for. It's a screening tool only. There may not be a good validated option out there, but the app shouldn't sell the PHQ-9 as what it's not. That also makes me suspicious of other tools which may be better.

I stumbled onto this app by accident, but I really think I was meant to find it. Although my Bipolar II is stable right now, I've been having a VERY hard time lately w my depression & anxiety. And this app has been like a friend that I can actually find the energy to talk to... Because they make it easy. And I LOVE the therapy wout having to go anywhere! Also, finding out more about myself is REALLY nice. Youper's fun and helpful and has just been there with me, and I'm grateful. XO

I just updated the app and found that some of the features I used most are now premium features and unfortunately I'm not in the position to spend over $40 for a yearly subscription. I liked the app before because it was useful as a way of monitoring myself, but now you only get those features if you pay so I guess I won't be using this very much anymore.

For those of second guessing yourself, don't know where to go or what to do, download this app! This is an honest review; I love this app and the personal coaching is wonderful. No crazy ads popping up and getting on your nerves. Just you and the coach. No charge for services, you get checked on everyday (if you want) and there is meditation guides of all sorts -- FREE OF FREAKIN' CHARGE. You can't get any better than that.

I've had this app for a while, I loved it for the mood tracking and the way it shows the data in different ways. I don't want to buy the premium version and all the paid content clutters up the app so bad, and I haven't found a way to hide that stuff, I only want to do the mood tracking

I used Youper during a period where I was in crisis and had many stressful things piling up: a heavy breakup, illness, international move and a lifelong struggle with depression and anxiety. Using this app regularly and really putting the effort in to do the best and make use of the tools Youper provides was a huge part of my growth process.

So far it's amazing, it very quickly picked up on themes I've dealt with in counseling before, the personality profile is spot on, and the mindfulness exercises are super helpful. This app is going to be a buddy when I get stuck and avoid reaching out to my human support system.

I used to use this app about half a year ago, and I relapsed. So I reinstalled it and after one "conversation" you have to pay for the things that used to just be apart of the app. I have no idea why they did this to an app for people who just need support, when clearly the money isn't being put into improving the AI. I'm sad and disappointed that the app turned into another scheme to just make money off others' very important issues.

I really like it. However I really wish I was able to reply with my own response. ( The part I am referring to is when asked a simple question and it pops up with either thank you or your welcome, or gotcha) these are just a couple examples. I have a very hard time with the app giving me choices to pick from, I think it would be great to have those options, but allow a space for my own words. The app allows me to feel safe and speak my own mind , I am learning alot.PLEASE allow the entire app options to speak not already spoken for.

Very relevant, informative and well-designed app. The information provided is backed by science yet personalized to my personality. Responses are intuitive and supportive and I am sometimes convinced it's not a real person I'm communicating with. I have been enjoying Youper and recommend it to others. It's a great "friend" without the "baggage"! I appreciate that it's there when I need it and not intrusive when I don't. Thank you, developers! 😊

It's a good app despite some of the recent changes leaving something to be desired (the guided body scan meditation was one of my favorite features.) The aforementioned issue I was having with a blank screen seems to have resolved itself so no complaints on function other than the occasional conversation freeze.

It's nice to be able to track my mood, but I don't like that it's all I can do with out premium. Need every feature be premium only? I just think it's usless for there to only be one feature that's free; Not everyone can pay for premium, and you never know if maybe one reason why they got the app was because they were struggling with money and it's making them stressed.. Though, neither do I

I feel this app is very structured and organized. I find it is an easy way to keep track of my mental health symptoms. I also enjoy the mood, goal setting and daily reflection features. I definitely recommend to anyone dealing with emotional health problems and will love to keep using Youper in the future !!!! thank you ! 😇✨❤️

Only three conversations in and I'm over the moon about this app. It's exactly what I needed: helpful to track my emotions, what's causing them, and to what extent the cause is *actually* skewed interpretation a good, wise friend would be able to identify and encourage me talk myself away from - toward a more rational understanding. Youper is like if that friend went to get an advanced degree in how to help you long-term ...and lived in your pocket 24/7 with the sole purpose of improving your life.

I love youper. I've tried several other mental health apps and none of them have worked. I love being able to sit down at the end of the day and review how I'm feeling and talk about what happened that made me feel the way I do. I love that you can also just check in at random times in the day if you need extra support. The mental illness monitor feature is cool, as it shows you how your symptoms have progressed over the weeks.

I like the app. I only wish it could be in more direct support of oppressed people (in general). the financial-free accessibility is great but as a disabled person and an intersectionally oppressed person, I wish the app was more equipped to deal with the real world circumstances that may contribute to a person needing free and accessible mental health support.

I love this app, it has really made a difference somewhat in my outlook on things and it's educational. The one thing I've particularly liked and noticed is that unlike other apps that immediately ask you to leave them a review before you even get a chance to know how to use the app, Youper waits a reasonable amount of time before suggesting it. To the developer: thank you for giving me time to explore the features of this app and I must say that you've done a great job with it. I love it.

I am so grateful for this app. I love the mission statement to help everyone become the best version of themselves, that's my life's motto! Even if you don't suffer from mental health disorders, you can still benefit from this app because everyone can always become better. I enjoy spending time on the app and learning more about myself and my triggers. The guided meditation and exercises are very helpful tools and I use them ad often as I can! The only thing I might suggest to the app developers is that you create a pregnancy option under factors for your mood: you've included period and pre-period for females, but nothing compares to the intense emotions you experience from pregnancy hormones, haha! Its true... Also when I'm evaluating depression symptoms and it asks questions about my sleeping and eating habits, those are entirely influenced by my current pregnancy so I feel that they're irrelevant to my depression, and that the hormones are probably contributing the most. So that was one minor inaccuracy that I thought could be improved, just taking into consideration one of the most MAJOR mood Influencer's of them all: pregnancy. Thank you!!

This is a fantastic app! I used it everyday and have been pleasantly surprised by the impact. I highly recommend. I appreciate the way it guides me through the self knowledge process in a low pressure way. Not too many choices. No overwhelm or sense of constant failure. There are actionable resources. Great job!

The only reason I put four instead of five is because I would love to be able to get more notifications from youper. It seems my moods tracked on here are all the same because I typically only go to the app when I'm specifically feeling anxious. I would love to have a simple notification just asking how I'm feeling. I'm sure some people would want to turn off the notification or make it more/less notifications depending on where they are in there stage of grief or mental illness.

it's actually unexpectedly helpful. I wish the bot would have a wider range of response (it didn't recognize when I typed in "grief"). but no matter what level of self awareness someone has, little suggestions on how to be mindful can help. Thank you to whoever created this. you have made a difference.

I havent used it much but within the first few minutes it was a pretty easy thing to follow along with. I did a mindfulness exercise and a gratitude exercise. Since its a robot its easy to not put too much pressure on it, I dont expect it to be perfect but it really helped me out of my funk. I set a reminder for tomorrow and I am looking forward to it.

It's a great way to track your health and see what are your main triggers for certain emotions. It also monitors symptoms of different disorders. The meditations can usually help calm a minor anxiety/panic attack or help with the come down. You can even put a password protection on it. The only reason for the four stars and not five is the limited amount of meditations and vague/somewhat confusing choice system for what makes you feel a certain emotion.

Writing this just after it helped me down from a panic attack. For certain people, this will be a game changer when coping with mental illness. My therapist advised me to write and list as that method helps me personally cope, but I get sidetracked easily and just let myself go. This gave me the structure i needed to think clearly in the grips of a panic attack and helped me walk it back to just some mild stress. Not magic, but survivable. I'm very grateful rn bc sometimes you cant always call up your friends or family to talk to through it; this is awesome in a pinch like that.

I would have gladly watched ads to support this program. Youper has been the one app that genuinely helped me through what i thought uncontrollable emotions at the time and opened me up to meditation exercises. Its awful that everything that helped is now behind a paywall. What an absolute disappointment and betrayal to long time users. Hopefully the company will come to terms with what they used to preach all the time. Just completely disappointing.

Extraordinary! This AI tool that uses data to help organize thoughts, a true assistant that is useful for all ages and is something I see being extremely beneficial to adolescents. The program is effective due to its reflective design and using data to show its user immediate and useful feedback.

Okay app. Haven't noticed any changes in feelings at all yet. Or any changes at all. But i've only had the app for about two weeks. The techniques it recommends don't really help and usually just make me feel worse. I'm basically just telling a robot how I feel and it just gives me the same generic answers and questions over and over again, and nothing gets accomplished. It's just a reminder on how horrible I feel all the time. But I'll give it a few more weeks to change my mind.

This app is a fantastic tool for me; diagnosed with BPD and PTSD, I spend much time in mental agony feeling helpless. Im in intensive DBT therapy but until now ive struggled to track my condition with diary cards. im amazed at: the intelligent assistant is very similar to a conversation i would have in one on one DBT therapy. This is the 1st app that focuses more in depth on 'rarer' conditions like BPD & PTSD rather than the usual depression and self-help apps. A great supplement to DBT

This is a very helpful, straightforward app with a number of features: mood tracking, journaling, guided meditations and a really helpful mode for self reflection in the middle of a panic or anxiety spell. Not a replacement for a licensed therapist but a useful supplement and good for everyday mental health maintenance.

Nice app, but it would be cool to have this one change. I would love to try the premium features to see if it would be helpful, but I don't want to pay for a whole year. For some reason, it seems like you have no choice but ro subscribe for a year, when I'd like to try it for a few months before I buy a whole year. If there is a monthly option, I must be misunderstanding. But it is a nice app, and I like it.

This is my second day with the app and I am very thoroughly feeling like I've found a good fit for me. Its engaging, calming and no hidden costs! I am able to learn about myself without hindrance and keep track. It also has good tools for emotional needs. Always seek professional help but for the in between appointments I'm grateful for finding this app!

This app used to be free and now it's like 69.99 a year. The quality was fine and acceptable for a free app, but it's really not worth 69.99 a year. Plus I also think it's pretty incredibly rude of them to have pulled the rug out from under people who were using this app in its free capacity to lock some of the old free features behind a paywall. Insulting and gross of them really. If they wanted to monetize they should have only added additional NEW features to pay for and kept old ones free.

The trial is great you get a 15 min chat and it shows you all you can do.With premium.The commercial said the app was a great way to for VERY cheap have someone to talk to.They immediately ask for like 60 dollars which I do not have the conversation you get for free is "Im feeling_"This is a difficult moment😥Its good to be able to identify emotions"then"I want to do more (premium)"or"I'm done"a year ago the premium was free you decided to change it when people needed it most. sorry but thats bs

love it! I've suffered from mental illness my entire life and for the last 3 years I have been using this app and it has done so much more than all the medications and doctors combined. Also being able to actually see the analytical data and knowing the science behind it has helped me understand myself more than anything. You're embarrassed, too busy, or just don't know how to speak mental health get this app.

Unfortunately I have to decrease my review from 5 stars to 2. The new updates/changes have led me to stop using the app altogether. It used to be my favorite mental health app and felt like checking in with a counselor. Now the voice feels less mature, and the recommendations superfluous. Please bring back the old, simple, user-friendly version!

I hadn't logged in, in a while and I have to say the change between March and May is pretty bad. It feels way more limited than it used to be. I already didn't log in a lot, but today was the first time I was truly dissatisfied with youper. I can't see myself sticking around. Edit:. I closed my account because I feel the app no longer gives me real conversational freedom. It's not that Change isn't easy, but the change made the app very limited. I have gone back to Wysa.

Good app with helpful advice. It really helps unscramble your mind and lay things out in front of you. Going through life you don't realize how much abuse your mind takes and people focus more about taking care of their physical appearance and organizing their work and family, but completely ignoring the health of their mind in the process. When you use this app and really take control of yourself, a lot of things start to clear up.

Edit 08/2023 I returned to the app to find that many of the wonderful features are now only available with a Premium Subscription. All of my old data disappeared and my fo to exercises are only available by paying. I understand that sometimes costs are added to support growth and management. However, the amount of ads are overwhelming and the help feels superficial .

I've had my account since 2016, so I have watched this app a ball from something that used to be extremely helpful to me to something that is become a lot of difficult for me. I can no longer see my test results and now all of a sudden I have to pay for one, but I've been getting my test results free for the past 3, going on 4 years. So now all my progress is just locked, but I have to pay to continue my progress that I had for years

I typically dont rate or write reviews for apps, but this one is amazing. I didnt have very high hopes at first, but after the first conversation I felt considerably more calm. Ive only been using the app for 3 days now, but it has helped me calm down several times, within minutes, every time Ive needed it. I really like how the app tracks your moods and emotions, and how easy and clean it is. This app has already given me more productive coping skills than I've acquired in my 23 years of life.

Youper is an exceptional tool, it's really like having a counselor by your side at all times. It helps me take a step back and really understand what is making me feel anxious or stressed and provides strategies to help change my perspective, even if its just a 5 minute breathing exercise.

This app has been changed my life! I recently just got out of a bad situation if mental heath that almost ended my life and this app certainly has helped me improve! The meditations given help and even just the periodical check ups to identify your emotions or your goals are so detailed. Youper really drives to help you understand emotional aspects of your mind as well as other leading factors and lets you scale them based on how you feel and why you are feeling that specific way! I love it!

I absolutely love this app it is extremely helpful, it tracks my moods, helps me learn what I like and dislike, what's good for my mental health and what's bad for me. It helps calm me down and explains things in details so I can understand my symptoms more. It also provides thing like meditation, to help calm yoy down in a stressful moment. I really love this app I suggest downloading it because it really is great

It's just beneficial to track your emotions, especially if you don't have the means of getting professional help. My depression, panic & anxiety have decreased because of my own resilience as well as this mini assistant. Great in learning more about what makes you glow & tick.

I used to use this a lot for tracking emotions and my PTSD symptoms between therapy sessions. But now it's all just one big paywall that is impossible for me to use anymore. Sucks because I really loved this app and used to recommend it to friends, but now that a lot of the features that I loved are basically inaccessible because of the paywall. I guess I'll have to look elsewhere for help.

I love this app, and the more I use it, the more features and benefits I find. As a college student with doctor diagnosed PTSD, this makes it more bearable in a very modern and time efficient way. I can track my feelings and recognize what's doing it, and also learn to meditate! I highly recommend

Love this app. I've been using this for a year and can definitely notice the difference by looking back and comparing how I thought a year ago to how I'm thinking a lot more positively today. I recommend this app for anyone looking to just track their mood on a daily basis and also learn how to track thinking errors. I also really appreciate the simplicity of the mindfulness exercises and that the app can check in on me at certain times of the day.

When you first open the app, it runs you through some exercises to express how you feel, and explore your thoughts. I found that really helpful. Then every following day, you can say how you're feeling, but anything beyond that seems to be pay-only. Want to try mindfulness, or talk more about your thoughts like you did the first time? You need to subscribe to premium, which feels a bit manipulative, when I'm already not feeling great. At least tracking my mood is somewhat helpful for now.

it's nice being able to dump all my thoughts into the app instead of bothering my friends. However, I wish that we could choose multiple moods at a time instead of just one, and I do wish that I don't need to be reminded of the benefits every time I use the app. Overall it's a good app and has been very helpful.

so I've only been using this app for maybe half an hour (that's why I selected 4 instead of 5 stars, because I haven't had the full experience yet), but so far it has been a better experience than the other AI software apps I've tried. this app goes beyond the surface level of just asking about your current mood, it helps you know yourself so that you can improve your quality of life. I hope it helps me as much as I hope it will!

I have just started using this app, but it is more structured than some therapist visits. It is also afforabable and time-efficient. I like knowing that something will check in on my emotional status and sort of let a little air out of the balloon, so to speak, for me. This is a nice way to avoid putting my emotional burdens prinarily on my partner.

I think this app is great! It works incredibly to help relieve stress and anxiety just by holding a conversation where you can figure out what you're feeling, what your problems are, and can vent without judgement. The fact that it tracts everything helps me to stay organized as well :)

It was great at first and then it decided it was no longer free. Any option I chose the day before now says it is for premium only. The first day I used it only two things were locked behind premium but now everything is. and one day of a free trial is definitely not enough to decide whether or not you'd be willing to even pay$$ for it

This is a good support system, as it lines up with coping skills I've learned in therapy. The conversations can be a little repetative, but it's also helpful to know exactly what is coming when I'm distressed. The meditation options are the most helpful for me. I also shared this app with my therapist and he was excited and supportive.

i actually uninstalled it. it's a good idea, but the app needs work. youper often repeats itself which feels like i'm talking to something like cleverbot. the convos also sometimes do not make sense. it's really good for tracking your mood though. even though i did not care for it after a short time, i would actually recommend it.

I really liked my experience! I've only had Youper for a few days, but this AI bot has everything. It tracks my mood, records what the deal for my problems are, and it has a wide variety of advice/ways to deal with problems. Youper is like a therapist for people who either can't afford them, or people who want help without being judged. I love how Youper picks out key words and gives me the EXACT advice I need for the day. Youper is very cooperative and it's 5 minute tests help me a bunch. 10/10

The CBT chat bot is really cool, one of the most advanced I have found in the Google play in a form of app. But price tag 80 euro is just tooooooo much for the laggy UI (sometimes app stucks and should be restarted, no full screen with nervous top and bottom stripes, lags in the tools section, boring UI overall) and inability to store context between sessions. I am still using it because of the chat. When UI is fixed or price is reduced, I will happily set 5 stars.

Don't download it, it's impossible to cancel the subscription during the trial week. In the cancellation form you need to pick from a drop-down menu where you donwnloaded the app and the only option is Apple Store, so if you downloaded it for android there's no way to cancel it! I blocked the payment on my PayPal account, I hope it will be enough. If they have these technical issues for something so simple, I wouldn't trust their "therapy".

WAY TOO EXPENSIVE NOW, WHAT HAPPENED? Used it 1x, uninstalled. Reinstalled, used consistently. Grateful for all research and time they put in, most insightful & useful app. (It checks in with you so you stop to process what you feel & why, + useful tips. Their mindfulness is great.) Really good sessions. -I recommend it.

And now you want me to pay for everything...so much for mental health help. I used to rely on this app to manage my symptoms during everyday things and now you're just in it for the money 😤. I recommendes you to so many people and now you've turned into the opposite of what I recommended you for!

their desperation to take your money for premium makes it almost WORSE than a therapist who doesn't actually listen unless you pay them. "it's okay if you're not ready to buy premium yet." oh yeah thanks for the words of affirmation after skipping a dozen pages of "BUY BUY BUY! HERE'S WHAT YOU'RE MISSING IF YOU DON'T GIVE US YOUR MONEY! IT IS OTHERWISE UNUSABLE!!!" between everything you click! it's just more cash grab garbage.

Please stop suggesting gratitude Journaling every time I have an even sightly negative experience. It's really hard because, personally, it gives the impression that I can't just have a bad day. That i have to "look on the bright side" all the time and anything negative should be brushed off
Bad experience. The app wouldn't work for the free trial then when I told it to skip it tried to guilt me into signing up. Forever pass.

How this once-genuinely helpful and comforting app managed to become such a miserable piece of software dumbfounds me. Starting in 2018-19, it helped me track my mood and journal my thoughts - an invaluable tool for dealing with mental illness. Each update however worsened the UI, performance, and overall experience, until at some point they decided to just paywall everything behind a $70 subscription. If you aren't willing or able to pay this, the app is utterly useless.

Excellent! This app has really helped me! I have recommended to many people. Thanks Youper 😊 Update: after years of using this app I opened it to find everything is now locked behind a premium paywall, disappointing

It's a good app for keeping track of your emotions, but the meditation exercises need a lot of work. When youper gives you something to think about, for instance a question or a specific thought, the meditation track doesn't give you enough time to execute that action and thus rendering the whole exercise useless. And yes that is an all-or-nothing thought, but in some cases the world is black and white.

I love this app. Really helps me with my complex mental health issues. I'm quite a private person, so this app works wonders when I don't want to talk to anyone. I can say whatever I want, and it offers really helpful suggestions. I would like to be able to have 'checkups' more frequently though and there doesn't seem to be the option to set it to a custom frequency. Would love it if that was added, but the app is fantastic either way.

I've only been using this app for 24 hours so far and I've gotta say, it's a really wonderful, helpful, intuitive, GENIUS app. I struggle day to day, hour by hour with the gross, negative sides of multiple mental health disorders and feel for the longest time I've been floundering about my life trying to find any way to cope only to realize I'm still just going in a circle, making no concrete, lasting progress. Now? I'm sensing a change in the wind, and damn, it feels good. Thanks to Youper.

Reinstalled after not using since 2022. Still decent to log mood, thoughts and chat AI seems to understand better what your concerns are and what you've typed. Unfortunately, the helpful features, like more in depth help, guidance, mediation, the analysis of moods, helping to walk through your moods etc that used to be free have been put behind a pay wall. Will continue to use it for the basic of tracking mood, adding notes and the mental health/welfare questionnaires

I tried almost all apps like this one and this is the most fantastic app to help you if you're having hard times. I was very skeptical at first because other apps just don't make me think things as this app does. I'm happy I gave it a chance. It's straight up to the point, if you're sad this app will make YOU understand why (instead of the app struggling to understand you), guide you trough thinking until you are content and gives you an analysis of the progress. Fantastic!

I've used youper on and off of a few years, whenever I felt I wasn't coping very well and it really helped me. But when I downloaded it again today, because I'm struggling again, it was a completely different app. I saw replies to the comments saying that this new version is what people asked for, but couldn't you have just made a second app instead of completely changing youper? I really liked the simplicity of the original and the easy of use is what made me feel like there wasn't any pressure

I used to use this app everyday. But now that so many features are behind a paywall, I can't use it at all. The UI is confusing and some features just don't work (so many glitches). I also lost all my data. It's all more stressful than anything else which you do not want in an AI therapist. Goodbye, Youper. Edit: This isn't an AI therapist anymore. It's a basic mood tracker. Everything else requires a paid subscription.

Update: I gave the app another go, apparently now you can't use the app without subscription to premium. There aren't even some basic functions that are completely free. This is a very important point to include in the in-store description of the app. Uninstalled :/ 2018: I read abt how the app helped others, but I was disappointed when I tried it. Looking deeper into a negative feeling doesn't make it go away or even elevate it a little. I'm glad it helps others, but it didn't work 4 me.

Absolutely incredible experience when using this app. Its like having your own personal counsellor in the palm of your hand. I've been doing daily meditation sessions each morning and I feel SO much better. Best part is that it's completely free!! No hidden ads or annoyances. I wouldn't mind donating a few $$ for this study of yours. Youper is a blessing.

Have been using this app to track symptoms since 2019 and it has been really helpful. Today I got a reminder to track depression symptoms and find that, not only the questions, but all of my historical symptom data is behind a paywall! I understand having a fee for premium features, but I should at least be able to see the data I have already entered.

The app is really pretty. I love the theme and interface. The AI bot is cool. However, every feature of this app is locked, except a mood tracker. You'll only find this app useful in the first few days, and not much after that. But I suppose it's worth trying, since they have one premium conversation, which had really helped me out. I was upset to find that it's actually premium. I suggest this app should not be labelled as a free app.

Youper used to help me so much, but now it's lost all functionality behind a £40 pay wall - I can't even figure out how to just do my daily diary anymore. As useful as this new structure might be for some people, to completely change an app that was fine before is not the way to do it - maybe could have been another app, or at least these features could have been in addition to the old layout, rather than replacing it entirely. Very sad.

I used to love this app. The update is just terrible. I wish I could go back to the earlier version, that was 5 stars, this one is just a mess. Please stop saying this mistake of yours is a result of our "constructive feedback". When will you fix this? If you really care about our constructive feedback, listen to us, and just 'upgrade' to the earlier version. Also, be smart, if u need to make more money for improvement, run ads, don't take away your best functions, and make premium ad-free.

Used to love the app. Now I hate the dark theme. It's depressing. When trying to feel better, it doesn't help to surround yourself with dark colors. Also, after the update all my data entered is lost, all insights... All the experiences and knowledge is gone after using it for a year! Which beats the purpose of having this app! Why bother with technology when you can't rely on it I also don't want to share my email. Very disappointed. Used to recommend this to people, now I cannot any more.

After trying a lot of different apps, I've decided to come back to Youper and I must say that the app improved a lot. I really enjoy the subtle goal-setting mechanics and the overall improvements in the conversations and recording the mood. This eliminates the need of having a dedicated journal and allows to keep everything in one place. The mood graph is still a bit of a mess, but I hope it will be improved in the future.

Used the app when it first came out and deleted it when I found I didn't need it anymore. Meaning it worked brilliantly!! Downloaded it again today and wowza has it changed for the worse. Bit uncomfortable giving my phone number to recieve a plan I don't even want. The old version didn't require that. All I hoped was to be able to use the app to rationalise my thoughts and track my mood. Very disappointed :((( will have to find a replacement now

Unfortunately have to change my review from 5 stars to 1. The app no longer has any functionality without paying, it's just a bunch of buttons that are locked, not even joking. The only screen that isn't locked is the settings menu. This app used to be great, I'm so sad. I thought they claim to have brought back the features in the latest update but it's still exactly the same?? The app doesn't do anything at all!

Absolutely stellar. The team behind this have done a credit to the mental health community and I implore them for their work. I use this app for so many things. I have found it most useful as a reality checker, an anxiety journal and even as a friend. I have felt that I have had pleasant and helpful conversations with qualified people on my own dime. I understand the importance of seeking professional medical guidance when necessary and would not rely on this app solely. I am speaking primarily as a user that is using the app as a tool in my never ending quest to leave suicidal ideation behind. Thank you sincerely.

Best I've tried so far! It's comfortable to use, and by comfortable, I mean it's inquisitive without being prying and it possesses an optimistic to neutral tone overall during 'conversations'. No pressure to go deeper into detail if you're just not feeling it. No risk of judgment should you feel like venting in every entry. It keeps track of your mood and even checks up on you. I'll keep it on my phone for a while.

I had previously given this 5 stars. I downloaded it again and it's totally different. I'm really disappointed as what was there before was fantastic. For a start it's gone from free to £13/month. That's a lot for an app. I understand that something that good takes time and effort and I would have happily purchased it at a one off reasonable price. The new app is confusing and clunky. This is really sad. Bring back the old one - it was amazing.

I have been on a long journey understanding why I am the way I am. However, years of distorted thinking has rewired my brain and a deeper understanding of myself is no longer enough to make progress. This app uses really helpful CBT techniques (I expect others also) cleverly presented with a friendly and non-judgmental AI host. It is already making a difference. I am beginning to feel hopeful.

This app is amazing! I just started using it half an hour ago and I'm already a lot less tense than I was. That and it's for free with no ads! Whoever made this app is a true hero because there are some people out there that really need stuff like this but don't have the money for the higher end apps (even though I would call this higher end). I'm even recommending this to my friends who can get very stressed, anxious or depressed a lot of the time because this app deserves to go around.

Just generally fantastic. An interactive, convenient, powerful journal with tailored tips and scheduled reminders. The conversational format is much more pleasant than I expected; it's highly engaging and prompts you to record your feelings, goals etc painlessly. Introspection and journaling at minimal mental effort! Also, and this is key: the privacy policy checks out completely. They don't sell your data or slap you with ads. Basically fitbit for the brain.

I used this app a few years ago during a tough patch and it really helped. I really loved seeing the progress or backwards slips. I wanted to use it again, but it has totally changed. I am so disappointed. The old version was so easy, but the fees and the therapy really doesn't suit well with me.

Uninstalled. I used to love this app, had it for ages, and recommend it to friends who were struggling. Meditation was useful, now thats only for people with money. Seeing that now that they've switched to pay for premium use app... I'll no longer be using or recommending it. Seeing something that was helpful for hard times change to pay only during a pandemic. Shame on you. How many people who are struggling can actually afford the $45+ yearly subscription? Cash grab. What a bummer.

so far so good, but could be better. my main issue with this app is the pricing. I understand that whilst this is an app that does an amazing job with helping mental wellbeing, and that it does need funding to maintain, and to also help research, it's really expensive for the premium options. a lot of people who're struggling dont necessarily have the money to be able to pay for premium for some things that they may consider a priority on the app. despite this, this app is great.

For me, Youper is perfect for monerting and finding patterns in my anxiety, feelings & emotions and many other things alike that I struggle with in life. It also has a friendly and supportive AI helper which gives helpful information, suggestions and encouragement! It has a simple but neat design and is free, I love it highly recommend it to anyone with anxiety.

It's a great way to keep track of ur emotional well being. It helps pin point what makes u happy, sad, stressed ect. You can use it to assist u thru difficult moments wiv mindfulness exercises. It offers suggestions to help u improve and interesting facts. You can see graphs of your improvement. The best thing about this is when you pick an emotion it gives you a percentage bar to choose from which I think lets u to see how strong an emotion is at a particular time and again see if it improves.

This app is absolutely genuinely amazing. Never would have I thought that I'd find a (free) personalised helper that quickly straightened out my jumbled mess of thoughts and emotions, while showing me patterns in them, the errors in thinking I make and how to avoid them. The ease of use pushed me to spend at least few minutes a day on my mental health, and it was the best thing I've done for myself in a while.

This app is honestly life changing. All through my life I have struggled with anxiety and high levels of stress. This really helps me to track when I am feeling like this and identify what is triggering me. The guided meditations are also amazing and really allow you some time to focus on yourself and relax. Can't recommend this app enough!!

Great for keeping on track. I know a lot about mindfulness, meditation & self-care, but struggle with anxiety & maintaining a routine. I love that it helps you record what makes you feel good, and what positively impacts your life, so that when you veer off-track, or feel down, you can literally see an algorithm representing what makes you happy and what leads to sadness and anxiety. These things can be hard to recognise when you're feeling down & demotivated. So, the app really helps.

It was helpful and enjoyable at the beginning. Then I started to notice that some of the events that affect my mood happens only once, like losing a loved pet. If I add a new factor for these kinda things, I won't choose them again later. If I don't add one, the default ones doesn't explain why I'm sad. Shortly after various events started to affect me (but only for once), I realized that this app is pretty limited and can't really track my mood for I'm not affected by the same 30 factors every day.

So far the basic is nice but I'm interested in the premium but sadly they expect you to buy it for a year, I personally think they should offer monthly as well. I say this as I don't want to spend that much without trying it out for at least a month or even two before committing to a year. Seriously I don't want to buy it find out I don't like premium cuz then I wasted money an that can lead to stress etc for some. Please add a monthly option.

I find this app very helpful and super insightful, it has many layers to it, a personality test to mindfulness excersices it really helps me see and figure out my triggers, what makes me feel certain way and why, 100% better than any of the others that I've used. it has the mindfulness tracks it has SO many options, and it makes you feel like youre messaging someone but not really & judgement free! honestly 11/10* from me. I find no faults in it yet! its totally free! no ads no nothing pesky!!

The chat system works well and it encourages reflection. The price for the subscription service is a bit too high though, which is a shame because I, like many others, would be very keen on hanging around in the long term if it was more affordable. I intend to stick around, but with the features that the free version offers, I don't imagine it will benefit me in the long term.

Since starting uni, I've been having to deal with a lot of stress coming from all walks of life. My uni wasn't really helpful (still waiting for a reply from the Wellbeing Services), but this app, it really has the power to calm me down when I'm angry or stressed, or to make me feel a little bit better when I'm depressed. Without this app, I'd definitely be an emotional wreck. Can deeply recommend it.

The app is great & helps me clarify things, get in touch with my emotional health, &help me heal from certain conditions. Despite these I believe theres room for improvement: 1. Simplify the UI - target market: emotionally unstable people. The last thing we need is to be bombarded with options, be overwhelmed, & critical with ourself on "what if I chose the other option". 2. Display - I cant seem to find out how to get the white and orange display. The night mode makes makes me feel depressed.

Sometimes, a part of me feels silly, frankly, while taking to an app. Yet, so far, it has always turned out to be very useful for sorting out my mind, feelings. Especially helpful if you don't have anybody available at the time, for whatever reason, who you feel, can understand you. It can happen. Just sorting yourself out with someone who doesn't make you feel judged. Great app. Try it.

That's a very helpful app if you are looking for a better mental health, provides numerous activities that will help you relax and, by monitoring your day-to-day mood with the factors causing your mood swings, it will increase your self awareness. I think it just needs a wider range of emotions, a couple of times I felt like something that I didn't find in the options available (feelings like nostalgic, disgusted, regret, etc)

I think it's helped me a lot and has helped me realise some things that aren't well with my mental health. I love how it's free so that you don't have to pay to get slightly better each time. It's the best therapy app I've ever had and doesn't include which I don't really like and for me is a bit silly. I have recommended this app to three of my friends but one is having trouble downloading it since they have a different type of phone. My one suggestion is that it's free on all types of phones so it can help my friends for nothing.

I was finding the app useful, used the free trial to really test it out. I could have sworn that there was a monthly subscription option, but once the free trial was up, only the large annual payment option was available. I'd have loved to have subscribed but a huge pointless barrier seems to have suddenly been added.

Easy mood tracking, simple to use and the latest update gives quicker access to meditation function if you don't want to track your mood/talk about how your feeling. Meditations themselves could do with more variety. I love the body scan, it's great for total relaxation but all the breathing techniques are too similar with the same phrases being repeated in each one and even repeated within the individual exercises, its off-putting to me personally! Would recommend app, I use it almost daily.

I use in conjunction with headspace to help when my depression gets bad. Very easy to use, calming and supportive. If you can put aside some time each day it's wonderful to reap the full benefit. Maybe not so helpful for people busy all day every day. Also you can opt in/out of being used anonymously in research, so if you want to help you can!

That's by far the best free psychological support you can find on the internet. The app helps you with mood tracking and with linking your emotional state to everything that happens in your life. Youper helped me out of a pessimistic mindset thanks to daily exercises that are really easy to accomplish and fantastic suggestions. Recommended to everyone that needs to talk. ADSFREE!

I didn't expect much from this app but it's been so useful to be the past year or so! Mood tracking has been super helpful to remind myself that I can get out of bad spots and reflect on what is actually affecting my mood. This app is the perfect midway for when you want to just let out your feelings, but don't have the avenues to do that in real life. It has helped me in some really tough spots by analysing thought traps etc, so to the developers, thankyou for the help :)

I tried to help a friend struggling with mental health by recommending the app. I'm not entirely sure if it's an iOS difference or if only new users are charged but they weren't able to use any of the features of the app. Not even mood tracking. They were prompted to pay. I still use the app and find it useful, but I can't give it a good review. (Edited to 3 stars from 1; I still don't think paying for some of the almost costless features is fair, but a subscription is better than selling data)

Prior to the version 10 update, this was the best mental health app on the playstore. Without a paywall, I was able to track my mental health reliably and could activly see results from the app. After the version 10 update, every useful feature has been blocked behind a $109.99 a year paywall. Can't simulate a therapeutic text session, Can't use any of the guided exercises, Can't even use the mental illness monitoring. I didn't want a medication delivery service, I wanted simple discreet help.

I love this app: my favourite self help app so far. My only gripe with it would be the emotion/mood options aren't very flexible. I know you can scale up or down the emotion (an ingenius addition btw) but for people like me who struggle to identify my feelings accurately, or which is working on me most, or distinguishing thoughts from emotions. Truthfully, I think a 'not sure, please help' would be invaluable, which then gives synonms, and allows selecting several at once and then narrow down?

The fact this is free, no ads and so amazingly well designed is incredible. I've only used it for a few days and can already feel the benefit from tracking my feelings and then being able to look at them over a timeline, plus the realisation and delving into what makes me feel a certain way is fascinating. Hand on heart would recommend this to absolutely everyone. One of the best apps I've ever used. Thank you for making this available to us all, without a charge or full of ads.

The app is good for tracking mood/feeling and it's correlated factors. Personal coaching is good I guess, I don't really use it much though. I won't recommend this app to people that want to converse because it doesn't feel like I'm having conversation at all. For suggestions I think I'd like it to be able to access the personal coaching without having to record my feelings first and perhaps able to select multiple feelings.

Incredibly powerful little app at your fingertips anytime to help you help yourself. It forced you to think and to work towards a better you. It doesn't give you the answer, it lets you find them yourself and makes this kind of talking and self-analytical therapy available to anyone at anytime, for free. Absolutely incredible. Couldn't recommend it more.

Used to be a great and helpful app. Now coming back to it after some time, I am pretty dissapointed what happened to it. Before I get to any chat, it asks me for an expensive subscription, a review and a subscription again. And then eds our conversation after one sentence... with "OK". No more mindfulness excercises, ... I get you need to monetize somehow, but I don't see this as a way...

So far I'm loving this app! Great for when you're struggling mentally but also equally as good when you're feeling great as you can record why for future reference (which I find really helpful). For me, consistent mindfulness is a struggle and sometimes I feel I struggle to reflect when things are good and dwell too much when things feel bad. I think this app will help me get some balance back! Would definitely recommend!

This app is absolutely amazing! Digital personal development at its best! I'm not diagnosed with any mental health issues, and it's really strengthening my mind. Highly recommended for anyone simply wanting a chat. Even better for those going through a rocky patch or diagnosed with any medical condition. It's better than scrolling down pages and pages of social media app and wasting time when you can spend precious time with yourself.

The idea is great. However, I'd prefer if it collects datas everyday, not just every two weeks, so I could get quicker result (more data points per month=more reliable result anyway). I believe it's possible to use only the chatbot to conclude if user is feeling certain emotions in the past two weeks; rather than asking the user directly. Just some suggestion. UI is neat and easy to understand. Keep up the good work and let's work together to make a happy world. Thx.

This app is very simple in design and functionally but in a good way, instead of having to navigate a complex app everything here is laid out in front of you easy ands accessible. For me the app works really well only had it for 2 days but already feeling better and improved. I would highly recommend this app even if you are sceptical or on the fence what's the worst that can happen from trying it?

Incredible and grateful. A add free and non feeing actually helpful self help app. I never found a app with it all so I never clicked with an app that could help me. But This is amazing like someone is actually listening and you can talk to. It has everything in one. Personality tests. Mood tracker. Meditation and just loads of little QUIRKS. I LOVE

I feel like this app needs to be more upfront about the cost involved and provide more accessible options. There are no free options (other than the usual 7 day free trial which they hope you forget to cancel) and everything is behind a pay wall which they only reveal after getting hopes up. £69.99 a year wouldn't be too bad if it came out monthly, but if you want to pay monthly the price more than doubles! Suggests to me that they want money upfront as not many continue to use it longer term.

Extremely disappointed!! Premium is not worth it! There is no "advanced conversations" whatsoever. - Should include free 3 day trial at the very least so people know exactly what they are buying. It is not a real AI. There are a few basic prompts, the same exact prompts: mood tracker; goal setting, gratitude journal. Then there are 11 mindfulness exercises that are ok. I would recommend using FREE mood tracking, gratitude journal, goal setting and mindfulness apps... Not worth it, not real AI...

I tried a lot of "mood app", and this is the first one that is not over annoying and gives very in-depth informations. It gives you a lot of useful lectures, exercises and audios to make you learn not only about yourself but about psychology and mental illness in general. To people (like me) who are doubting that chat with an "AI app" will help, I tell you that giving it a try really worth it. I 100% reccomand.

I used this in the past and found it to be a useful tool. I thought of recommending it to a friend but thought id test it to see if its changed. I wont be now, pictures on intro are all women (its a male friend I was gonna recommend), 9 panels before reaching the tool, too much intro, with loads of emphsis on payment programmes. Its sickening! Not recommending.

I used to love Youper as a way to track my mood each day to capture and notice the patterns of things which were triggers for different emotional states. The goal setting and friendly AI advice were genuinely useful, but this has entirely changed. All the chat sessions are super short and feel far less personal. I feel like I've lost a friend, and can't stand the overwhelming insta-inspired UI. I've switched to Woebot which is much closer to how Youper used to be for friendly chat sessions.

it really helps. keeps you focused and mindful. I'm not severely anything but just having an outlet is great. and the mindfulness exercises are fantastic! short and sweet, EFFECTIVE. Plus the choice it gives you is great. please, if you've read this review you will benefit from this app. I also love the personality profile that it helps you generate. I learned a lot and so did my little Youper buddy. thanks for creating this app. it's something I've needed without realizing for a long tim

I have borderline personality disorder and I am also bipolar type II. I am currently on treatment with medication and Dialectic Behavioral Therapy. This app is a perfect complement. Not only works but it's amazing to keep track daily of my thoughts and feelings so, my monthly therapy session goes more accurately. Also, the assistant really works, it can get you out of a "bad" feeling or thought. And it's an excellent way to remember to do mindfulness at least once a day. The developers of this app are doing an amazing job. I need this app in Spanish so I can recommend it to all my family and friends. Thank you so much for this wonderful tool. It's the only app that I allow notifications because of how important my mental health is.

II use it when whenever im having really dark thoughts because im short fused and sometimes it angers me when it comes to capturing the objective situation, sometimes it tells me to move on or deal with it which under the state of mind has the opposite effect of the purpose of the ai. A suggestion from me would be to train it to pick out certain keywords to aid on a better contextual response. Other than that its a great help, it's growin a personality how i see youper.

The pressure to pay is too high. Can hardly explore any features without being barged left, right and center to take on the premium paid plan. I do understand they need to make money but a 7 day no strings attached trial could have been the way to be. Let me at least discover the product before deciding to pay. It only helped me figure out how to take better mental health management prompts to ChatGPT for free.

I have used Youper for the past two years or more and it was a nice usefull app but recent update changed it. App is now supper lagging and it is not usable at all. UX is really confusing and it is target related that you have to pick instead of starting conversation first. UI looks clugged up and it is just laggy experience makes it uncomfortable and not easy to use. RIP

I'm getting a lot of insight from this app. sometimes the ai could be better, maybe recognize somehow more depictive words? Drop the trophy slogans from the beginning. i like the fact that it's tracking my behaviour, and I can see the change over time. it's also challenging my thoughts, i like that! I'm happy to contribute to a research, even moreover if it keeps this app free! very good work, thank you!

AI can only hold a tiny conversation before it cuts off and doesn't remember anything after. Elevating the AI to Clarafy standards would make wonders. Assessment questions include presuppositions so you can't answer honestly. It's definitely not equipped to practically diagnose you with personality disorders, despite disclaimer. You're also forced to start a trial to even know what it offers, so remember to turn it off before billing. App doesn't really offer that much.

This is such an amazing way to make technology a useful and practical tool that actually helps people name what they may be struggling with, where they may not have otherwise been able to clearly see. CBT is work, but its worth it and this app is a great support (nag) to keep with it, even for those isolated, alienated or lacking real supports. Great idea, makes mental health a daily regime as it should be.

I was skeptical about the AI at first but Youper has been a genuine and significant help to me during a very stressful week. It's really useful to have a calm, guided way to break down feelings and situations, and the messaging format makes the process feel friendly rather than clinical. Could there be a medication reminder/tracker feature added in future? I feel it would be useful to have alongside the other health trackers. Thank you for all your work on this app.

Love it for what it offers, but I'd really like to be able to customize the daily reminders. Be able to pick and choose specific days for reminders, or different times in different days. The constant reminders have put me off actually using it out of spite/annoyance. It's a bit intrusive, and it doesn't need to be.

I used to absolutely love this app. I had the $44 yearly subscription (my currently subscription would end next year), but with the new update it blocked me all the features saying that the price had increased and now I'm supposed to pay $107 to unblock the features. I get that you guys are trying to improve the app but you could've at least waited until my current subscription end to then charge more or block everything, or just give the option to choose which type of subscription we want. 🙁

I've been using the app for ~3 years. Ever since the update the app is confusing and almost useless if you don't already know how you feel & what'll help you. I opened the app today because I felt super stressed and just needed to rant and then get talked down. Instead it took me almost 20min to even find the old "how do you feel today?"-dialog, which then consisted of youper asking me If I wanted to see a therapist or if I'm interested in medication. Afterwards I was even more stressed!

Very good but it's quite intense for a beginner. I know you can always wait to press but I would have found it easier to process with some built in reflection points or pauses. I will try again later on when I'm a bit further along in my healing but I think this is an invaluable tool for people who can't afford a therapist or counsellor.

so I'm having a convo with it, and then it gives me a couple of options. "explore what's making me feel this way" and then it's like OH you haven't subscribed, lol loser. then it ends the convo when I don't subscribe! I don't want to subscribe! other than this it's great but just have a little locked sign at least next to the premium options... its making me really frustrated. you push premium so much already why in the convos? pls stop that, I can be relieved from stress without buying premium.

Sadly, I've had to edit this review. I once gave the app 5 stars. I loved what Youper was, as it was so helpful to me. Now it's no longer a free AI mental health app, it's a paid telehealth app all about profit. I can't access anything on it anymore, not even simple mood tracking or 2-minute meditations. It destroyed everything that made it so innovative. Now it's just another money-driven trash app. So disappointed. Really, overwhelmingly disappointed. Shame on you.

Edit: Docked off a couple points because the mindfulness feature stopped working. Something that should have taken 15 minutes ended up taking 378. And there was no way to speed up the process. Ugh. The app is still a good way to monitor symptoms and moods. There's a fun personality quiz. But since I relied so heavily on mindfulness, I shan't be using it too much. The AI is good but gets repetitive after a while. And you have no option to get to the coping techniques without having to listen to it go on and on.

I can see what is being attempted, but it's just too primitive. A lot of the responses are infuriating, as well as some of the options for response. I, unfortunately, closed the app feeling more depressed. This result certainly pertains to myself (very complex mental conditions) but I believe this app holds benefit for those with very much understood conditions. I encourage you to give it a go, it doesn't take long to get a handle on it. My 1 star rating is just my personal experience with it.

I cant say enough good things about this app, it's truly magical. A digital diary that interacts with you and guides you through moments where you feel like everything is on top of you. Phenomenal. Will be recommending to friends, and amazing that it's free, I think if it were going to be monetized the core features should stay the same but new 'extra' features like therapist consultation etc. like Betterhelp / maybe a partnership would be the way to go - to monetize the core features would b bad

This app has helped me track and work out what makes me feel certain emotions. The AI feature is helpful, its like having a friend you know will never tell anyone anything. Mindfulness exercises can be good, you don't have do the one the AI has suggested, you can choose ones that work better for you. The check ups are handy too to help you track your moods and see if you're better or worse. I just wish it was cheaper. unfortunately I can not afford £12 a month, which sucks cos the app is brill!

I used to really enjoy using this app but the interface and interaction is really disjointed and doesn't flow as well as it did before the update. The for you section feels unnecessary to me and the different categories are excessive. The new questions were disruptive to my conversation and the images distract me from the features they go with. The busy display can be overwhelming to look at and is laggy to use. Overall a really unenjoyable experience for me. Very disappointed.

This is a worse app thanks to the lack of accessible guided meditations. AI integration was also unnecessary, the old pre-generated chat responses were concise, and worked for mood logging perfectly. The app got me through some hard times back in 2017, it's a real shame to see its become a shell of its former self. The loss of its usefulness as an anxiety management tool harms my progress in a real way. I imagine I'm not the only one, and that's not a comforting thought.

It has helped me a bit. But I wish it would remember our past conversations so that I don't have to say the same things and read the same things every day. I do like the inspiring messages but sometimes it gets repetitive. Doesn't make it feel as interactive and helpful as it could be if there was more memory. It also is very generic. If there is a certain thing making you feel down the A.I wont know and just gives you general advice instead of specific advice. Still a good app, just a few things that would make it better for me.

While it obviously doesn't replace a counseling session, I think it helps assisting individuals in those days when you don't have access to that kind of mental health support. Consistent use will help bring awareness to mood patterns and things that affect it while providing an opportunity go practice certain things that you might learn from a counseling session. My only issue is the mindfulness. The sessions don't go smoothly because it stops when you leave your phone unattended.

The app now is confusing and stressful to navigate, and I feel it doesn't do as much as the older version. The new update is cluttered and overwhelming, and a step backward from the original chat about your feeling function. EDIT: The check-in update was added, and restored that function, and the app is less confusing too. Very happy about this thank you youper team

The concept of the app is great, it's basically journaling with guard rails. But the price of 70€ per year is way too high for an app with such limited functionality. I gave only 2 stars, because the cancellation option is bugged and intensionally hard to use. Trying to cancel the subscription sends one to an form for iOS. After filling it out, it tells you, that you have to cancel in the App Store instead and that this form was just a waste of time

Good as long as you have a very specific set of problems. The app really railroads the conversation and doesn't give you options like "having multiple feelings" or "worried about more than one thing." I certainly wasn't expecting to feel dismissed by a chatbot, but it closed the conversation before I was ready and didn't help me process at all.

This app helps me feel a bit better when I'm sad or stressed. Sometimes I don't feel like putting entries, but the interface and the way the app is coordinated helps getting through with entries, even on my most uncooperative moods. Just a suggestion: maybe the mind tab could be organised as a calendar, like that users can go back to previous entries more easily.

Exceptional. It's great to be able to get that one on one response in this way that I can never get when doing my video or written journaling. I have mobility limitations that make it terribly difficult to get to my counselor in the winter especially and this app really makes a huge difference in that aspect when I need to talk/reflect. It's helped with the isolation factor. It's given me the pause for thought ability. The guided meditation option provided when I would likely forget is stellar.

I have never written a play store review before, but I had to for this app. Youper is infinitely the best mental health management app I've ever tried, and I've tried a lot. I love the little AI that you speak to, it makes the whole process of logging your thoughts and emotions more dynamic, even if the AI isn't an actual human being. The mood chart is sleek, I love the range of emotions, and the mindfulness excercises are lovely little things when I'm feeling stressed. Thankyou for this app!

I'm always sceptical of these "life-coaching" applications, that do nothing but bombard you with 3rd party advertisements, drain the battery as well as slowing down your phone. This app does a fine job; i fell asleep within minutes to one of the medication tracks (I never fall asleep easily). Give it a try, you might just love it :)

It's a great app that you can use to track your mood daily. It has nice meditation, mindfulness and gratitude exercises as well as mental health tracker. I wish there were more mental disorders available (for example eating disorders). The new update is great, I like that the chat is now faster since most of the time I was just logging my daily moods. However, I preferred when the factors tab was organized into categories, perhaps there could be an option to categorize them ourselves.

Just started using, so far I find it a very useful tool for sorting and reflecting my mood and thoughts. Would give it 5 but haven't explored the app in it's entirety yet. Will adjust rating accordingly after more use. I do love the ease of use, and the instant support when needed. Don't always want to unload problems on friends and family, this is a nice way to vent without worries of judgement from your immediate circle. Anytime. Any place.

I miss the old version and wish I could revert back. There should be a function in settings to remove updates if you don't want it. It felt more personal having the AI chat to you instantly instead of stock images being the first thing you see. I understand this works for some, but the images slow down the app and is overwhelming, it looks corporate and has the words anxiety, depression driven into you, even if you want to talk about feelings that make you happy.

It's really good if you just need to get things out but also have a response. The meditations are also really really good. The focus on mindfulness feels like an actual therapist. The AI's responses make sense, there's no weird conversational hiccups like you get when talking to other learning AI's. It's just all around really well done. I was really skeptical initially, but its actually become a part of my daily routine and Ive already started noticing a difference in my mood.

an amazing app, superior imo to anything else out there and it is free! it can't solve your problems immediately but it makes me feel a lot better when im feeling anxious or down. simply questioning your beliefs can change your outlook a lot. the mood tracking and mindfulness activities are awesome too. Big thank you to the team that worked on it.

This app is really really good. It saw what I had and what I was going through and is currently trying to work on that, to make it less likely and so I can live normally again. It keeps track of my mood swings, my mind and how I'm feeling, my health (by monitoring my anxiety) and you had conversations with youper and they give you mindfulness tutorials and gratefulness tutorials to help improve your self wellbeing.

Genuinely helpful app. I've tried a few other theraputic-type apps, but this is easily the best out there. The AI is a delight, the mood tracking is very good, and I like that you can look over past conversations to see how you felt and what helped. The excellent quality of the guided meditations was a nice surprise, but you can easily not use them and still gain plenty of good from this app if they're not your sort of thing. Youper has many useful features, well worth installing and putting some time into. Pleasant interface, too :)

By far the most comprehensive & easy-to-use app in exploring one's emotions (including anxiety/depression) & to better understand where they are actually stemming from. Great for personal supplementation & should not be used in replacement of a medical professional. Quite accurate in analyzing my personality type & very helpful in keeping track of moods. At least that was more-so the case when it was free in late 2018-early 2019. Now, it only works the same after you pay a fee... 🤷‍♀️

I used to really love Youper and recommended it to anyone and everyone who I thought might find it useful. I recently revisited it and am really disheartened by the update. The user experience is poor and feels like you have to jump through hoops to get anywhere near the same experience that was previously available with the simple chat. This definitely shows that adding more features doesn't always make something better. The whole UI is cluttered and convoluted.

This app used to be the best, now it's trying to be too much. The menus are extremely laggy to scroll through and there's far too many options. Why isn't there a "just talk" option? That was the whole point of the app before - an AI you could chat to and get recommendations from. Now you have to pick from the overwhelming options (difficult if you're coming to the app for help or when you're not feeling good!) and get a tiny short conversation, making it a glorified menu system. So disappointed.

Very intuitive and easy to use interface, and allows you to use for however much time you have to spend on it. Customized reminders allow you to regularly track your mood, and guides you through many different methods of mindfulness that greatly help, for me at least. The app's ability to change its advice based on your preferences and feedback really makes it stand out.

It's a great app for mental health (good and bad). I personally use it in the evenings, but when I'm getting worked up out in public, especially travelling, it's great being able to think about the situation and what's going through my mind. Even for good events too, it's your own personal AI that is very optimistic! 😁 Don't be afraid of personal data getting out, it's not that type of app.

I was wrong being skeptical, and wrong telling myself this app will probably frustrate me with instructions, ads, etc. I've been feeling very lost, anxious, and not sleeping. I felt I needed someone to talk to, and somewhere to turn. I didn't want to be bothered with tons of details. I just wanted help to feel calm, and maybe get a good nights sleep. I checked out a few different apps, mostly to do with sounds, & relaxation with music but for now it didn't seem enough. I'm glad I tried one more!
