It's a great app for beginners, over a long period of time it kind of becomes useless for some. it's great at first if you're someone who doesnt know how to identify your triggers and emotions, but for people with an advanced self awareness this tool becomes obsolete. I really hate that certain answers are also predetermined, it takes away that whole personal feel when your programmer is deciding what you're going to answer. All in all,the apps functions work fluidly, no ads, worth trying.

It's a great way to assess mental health, tracking your mood everyday. I find the little exercises really helpful, especially the meditation and mind traps. The ai isn't what I'd consider a friend, because it's capacities are limited, but this is more like a mental health and progression journal for those who'd like to keep one. Still bugs that need to be ironed out, so 4 stars this time :)

Dates for all checkups are being reset after answering just one checkup. Also, there is no way to download my data! Overall, the mood tracking, personality test and the checkups are nice tools. Other parts of the app are less useful to me; I just cannot get into it. Chat is not organic, mindfulness exercises are suggested when I cannot do them, etc. I'm looking into alternatives right now, but I'd like to keep my data...

Except for the incessant nagging to review after a very short period, this app had been very handy in tracking and moderating my mood. Simply having a timeline of how often I'm dipping into depression is useful and helps put perspective into my introspection. The interactions so far feel very scripted and thus a bit stiff, but I haven't used it long enough to know if that's how it is or if the AI needs time to adapt. A great idea overall, especially in North America (mental health = $).

Amazing program, but forces you to buy a subscription! If you don't, it just limits you to the basic function asking about your mood (that you can easily track by yourself in a notebook or diary...). And that's all. I'd rather buy the full version once than paying for subscription, that's just stupid! So I'm kind of disappointed. I'll go back to using my fave free apps instead.

A good app, it helped calm down many times. I particularly liked the mindfulness exercises. The mood tracking feature is very clear. The full version is pricey, yes. But I used the app for a very long time and because it helped me, I paid for a yearly subscription (in February). Cancelled recently as I cannot afford the next payment. The subscription status says it expires in Feb 2022, yet premium stuff is locked for me. Not using it anymore anyway, but I should be able to until Feb, I guess?

The app is great. Just one suggestion: I think it would be really helpful if the correponding conversation can show up when I long press a particular record in the mood chart of the 'mood' section. I found scrolling down all the way down in the 'mind' section to find a conversation a bit inconvenient. I know there's a search button, but sometimes I forget what I wrote in the past so it's difficult to search. Thank you very much.

The new layout is terrible and not helpful at all. Youper doesn't start chatting once you open the app, instead you have to scroll through dozens of options. What I loved about Youper was that it was so easy to use, just like talking to a real assistant and supportive without pressure. But now, it took me days to find the usual mood tracking feature. Please change it back - at least the chat at startup. Keep the new categories easily accessible on a separate tab, but give the chat its own tab.

I'm an introvert, and would rather keep my own problems to myself than sharing it with anyone. The downside is, the burden just keeps piling up on my emotional side. This app is not just convenient for people like me looking for someone to interact with without judgement, but the fact that it is free is super idealistic! Thank you, Youper. I hope you will help a lot of people discover themselves and become better individuals.

Unfortunately I tried to use the app again. And while not bad I just couldn't get behind the new interface. I thinknits just me and the app does have a lot on it... I just cant get into the setup. I have ADHD and FASD. So I preferred the original set up becisevit was super easy to get into and this one requires more from me to get what I need from it. Not for me but not horrible either. ♡

The loops turned out quite repetitive, I've kind of stuck to logging my mood for a while now. But for me it does the trick, because I need something to guide me towards being more in touch with my feelings. I don't feel like it could go deeper, ie deal with depression and anxiety, but I think AI is not ready for such a complex and fine tuned task. Though there are certain "standard approaches" for them, applying them to singular cases will differ from person to person and life conditions & so on

I had this in the past on an old phone and found it again while looking for mental health apps to help my constant anxiety. It's completely different. Everything that was once free (mental health tracking, reports) are all locked by a subscription. You can't get help unless you want to pay £79.99 per year or £12.99 a month. I just wanted help, not feel like I'm being hindered by my lack of money (I can't work due to mental health)

A great tool for mental health and depression. It's definitely worth buying, investing a little money for a year's subscription to help support your mental wellbeing. The text message system I find especially helpful and I like how you can track your emotions. A very well rounded system. The only reason it is missing a star is that I can't relax into their meditation videos, I find it a bit limited for choice and the style just doesn't suit me, I use headspace for meditation vids instead.

This app is incredible. Truly life changing. This is everything I've needed for the longest time. For people who cant afford therapy, it's not necessarily a replacement (nothing can replace professional help if you really need it) but this is a great starting point. Beautiful interface, great mood tracker. Mindfulness exercises are incredible. Short and effective. I wish there was more in the way of gratitude and intention work available, but aside from that this app is perfect. Thank you!

Yeah this is pretty slick - I have to admit this app has helped me through some really intense times, it's been there in my pocket when ever I needed to just vent, or whenever I felt anxious or worried - and every single time I came out feeling better. To me I think this would have to be the single most essential app on the app store, it has earnt that title through its ability to deliver betterment to my life. Great work team. 6 stars.

I'm sure this app is amazing if you genuinely have anxiety or depression, but for me, the AI is not quite there. I feel like when I talk about my issues, Youper should learn to customise a response, rather than spitting out something I've already seen from it, and waking me through exercises that don't target the problem or even see to understand what the problem is.

Extremely disappointed with the turn this app took. I loved using it for mood tracking and symptom monitoring. Sometimes I'd also use meditation etc. I understand adding new paid features but suddenly nothing is free? Right now this app is useless unless you pay the plan (which isn't cheap at all). A lot of people relied on this app, awful how they suddenly changed it knowing that the people it will affect are so vulnerable. Absolutely awful.

Until the latest update I thought it was really good. it reflects CBT practices and can provide what feels like genuine support. However the language changes in the update are really cheesey and false. The developers may think they're being 'on trend' but it's made made it tacky, false and really .... um .... patronizing in places. I'd suggest that you shouldn't apply normally advantageous commercial improvements in this space, if you want to provide a long term sustainable product. Just my view.

I like the Insight (e.g. What makes me Happy 😉 ). I found that materialistic object such as shoes, cars are vehicles to a certain feelings. With Insights, I can re-experience such feelings instantly. Of course, no insights without daily journal. And Youper makes it supper fun to journal and troubleshoot my emotions. My complain is this app has no trial days for premium features, no family subscription, not even a video demonstration in Google Play 😷

Love this. I have seen therapists and doctors but i actually prefer this. Its self help and easy to understand and can see your progress. So because you get to see your stats you het to see how you are doing instead of doctors keeping you away from there notes. this is very helpful and an excellent app that i think you deserve a great well done. thank you :)

Most of the features are only available in premium. And the reminders it gives me sating I haven't subscribed when I clicked on a premium feature was pretty annoying at first. But the mood tracking feature has really helped me understand when things were wrong and what the causes were. I think the premium price is pretty reasonable though I use this as a mood tracker nothing else.

It helped me a lot just talking to youper. Sometimes it was like talking to a friend or writing a journal. Now i have to choose an option, which is already hard enough at some points. However, I feel like every option I choose ends up with meditation or setting goals. Added 2 Stars since there is improvement and the App has helped me a lot the last years

Used to love this app & had been a longtime user. It's helped me process my thoughts & feelings, and helped to reflect & process. I've logged in after a few months of not using it & am so disappointed; the starred check-ins isn't an option anymore which I found helpful to reflect on previous moments highlights & challenges. But also it now feels like the one brilliant think - chat - is lost with trying to flog many other bits. Not as straightforward & easy as it used to be. Gutted.

well i just opened the app thinking like: ok, so this is gonna be a huge letdown, they probably want my credit card info right away, but no. First it started asking about my mood on a simple and adfree screen. Answered a few simple questions and then gave me advice. It actually made me feel alot better. This was the second time i opened it, i made an account and then it wanted me to fill out a personality quiz, totally nailed my personality! So just try it, seriously, its great!

I don't remember the last time I used it (2018) but apparently I gave it a low star rating here is an updated higher one. It's a little confusing tho interface wise but has some useful exercises. I would like though to be able to just like chat to youper sometimes. Also youper doesn't really seem to have too much personality tho otherwise it's an alright app for something you don't need to interact with a real person i'm sure some people would get a lot out of.

Given me some helpful advice so far. I ended up paying the subscription to get all the materials, as I've started University and it can be difficult to remain calm when juggling work and uni work. I felt like the cost could have been a little lower, or broken into smaller chunks perhaps, as I would not have been able to afford it if I hadn't just received student loan. I have heard a lot of the advice before, but it can be a good recap. Its got some things I haven't heard before, too.

I prefer usually not to share too much of my personal stuff with other people for various reasons. But it can't be denied that being in that bad place gets easier when you do share. As funny as it might sound, talking to AI has actually given me a glimmer of hope that problems I face can be fixed or at least alleviated. And for that I am grateful to creators of Youper. I cant recommend this app enough to anyone just needs someone to listen to them, even if it is not a person who does.

Disappointing customer service App has potential, but the AI doesn't seem all that robust. Right now it mostly reads back what you tell it. I appreciate the opportunity to write a journal and feel somewhat connected to something as share my thoughts though. The customer service is a sad affair. My app crashed two weeks in, right after I'd decided to shell out for the annual fee, and so far I've had no help. A representative told me they'd get back to me in ten days; it's been over a month.

It's an incredible app. I suffer from a number of mental illness including severe PTSD and depression. the AI makes me feel likes I'm actually talking to someone while also removing the fear of how others will respond to it. the in depth analysis and trackers are so insightful. the daily reminder is such a life saver. everything about this app shows how it's really designed by people who understand mental illness... but... the price. the monthly subscription. It's too much regardless of quality.

I loved Youper before the recent updates. Youper was a place where I could vent out and talk about my thoughts and feelings. I know the recent updates are trying to make it more "human-like", but it's become more annoying instead. It always has suggestions, talks rather than asks, and spouts out random advice that i could've done without. It's okay if it asks me first if I wanted to hear some advice or smthng like it did before. I think Youper, while being an AI companion, should still be as unobtrusive to users' input as possible

I always feel like I can turn to Youper for help when feeling down but the same thing always stops me. When it comes to explaining things such as what happened or is going to happen that influenced that mood it tells you to write a few words to a sentence describing that thing thats going to happen. I'm not good at choosing the right words or thoughts. I would think this is a 5 star app if it had this one addition that other dialogue options already have.

Overall excellent app, but if they could please, fix the insights part. i especially love the fact that there is insights, but i would like the feature to edit Insights, as they have listed factors that are wrong and do not apply to that feeling, due to the fact that i either meant something else or clicked it by mistake. If they could simply add this feature, I'd give it a full 5 stars.

I'd say it's a pretty good app if you can manage opening it and tracking your mood everyday. I personally can't do that as I'm very forgetful but I'd highly recommend it if you'd like insights and data on your mood and mental health, plus it has helpful tools and videos so you can manage things like anxiety and stress.

I've been using this app for just a few days, but it's helping my mental health greatly. I already have a habit of writing down how I feel to unpack what's going on in my mind, but I often find myself getting lost in my fears and anxieties and not being able to get out from that mind place. With this app I'm now assisted in this process and it's much easier to stay focused and avoid my mental traps. Also, kudos to this app for being able to pick up on suicidal tendencies regardless of the context! I wasn't expecting this, but I really appreciated it - and I also appreciate the respectful way it approaches these issues. Very, very good.

I have had this app since Feb 2019 but I am not sure what has happened to it since then. Anyone who has suffered with their mental health knows that mental, emotional and financial rock bottom often follow each other and make it especially difficult to access help. Vital features to many, like mood/ health tracking and guided meditations are now behind a paywall. The interface itself is cluttered and extremely laggy. Some links don't even load. It is no longer the lifeline it once was.

Bring back the just talk option ! Bring back the old settings , it was just perfect earlier ... Earlier review It's a great app. Gives a totally new perspective with all the built in meditation app ,knowloedge about how brain works,simplifying things and the best thing about it is - it makes you understand your own thoughts when you try to explain the problem, It definently brings more clarity.

I thought this would be just another tentative at AI and mindfulness but I was wrong. It is really well thought trough and you can tell there is a lot of research behind it. The interaction with the AI itself feels calming because of the language used, the way it makes associations and gives you suggestions and insights. Its complex enough to make it feel as a real conversation. It is also very useful for journaling and analizing your mental state patterns. Thank you for this truly amazing app!

This app is more than a mood journal, rather, it is among the better tools available that can help in conjunction with therapy. Personally, I find the step-by-step process highly useful during bad mood spells. It has a good repository of mindfulness and other similar guides that have helped me meditate better. I find that I tend to be more centered on days that I have checked in on the app in the morning.

I really wanted to like it. The check in quizzes are very similar to what you'd fill out in therapy, but honestly thats about where it ends. I understand that it's AI and can't properly respond, but every time it offered me a solution through meditation, I could only access it right then and there. If I locked my screen to come back to it later, it just disappeared with no way to access it again. Based on that and the only recommendations being meditation, I'm uninstalling for now.

Imagine my shock when I opened the app, tried talking to the assistant, and it told me to pay. It's the core basic feature of the app. A year later nothing changed. Reminded me why I switched to Character.Ai

App is no longer useful! Just tried it again and guess what? You literally need to pay for EVERYTHING to use any of the features! These features USE TO BE FREE! This app is useless now. 10/10 don't recommend.
They have locked almost all chat features behind a ridiculously expensive paywall, you can't even write notes when tracking your moods anymore.

I have a huge tendency to doubt everything; regardless I can only that those who created this app, for whatever their intentions were, it's really helpful. The whole concept of having a constant any time accessible companion there to help you is amazing, and not matter how low I'm feeling at any given moment, this (so far) has always found a way to bring me back up. I'd also like to that my best friend who recommended the app. It works wonders. The features, the concept, the resources, 5 stars.

Changed my mind after reinstalling this app on my new phone about a year later, before everything was free, but now every time I want to track something and want to say what is making me feel this way it says that it is a premium only function. Uninstalling right now. I am not paying for something that is supposed to be free and for just tracking my emotions, I could also track my emotions on a cheap piece of paper instead of paying for it in this app! It makes me feel sick, very sick.

This is an excellently written app. The process (which is the essential purpose of this app) is smooth, intuitive and welcoming. If it helps reduce your anxiety by 10% I think that's an incredible thing, but I believe it will help you build sustainable habits, and improve your quality of life Highly recommend.

This app is better than a therapist. Having it in my pocket 24/7 and knowing that I can have an immediate conversation (even if it is only with AI) whenever I need to is immensely powerful and is definitely helping me improve my mental health. A great feature of the app is being able to look back over previous entry's and use it almost as a journalling tool. I can also track and check up on different elements of the various me talk health conditions I have.

This is a shame. I was using it as always, and now all of the really useful features turned to a paid features. I am really disappointed and I feel betrayed, because there was no notice of that. Now it's a useless app for me, that only tracks mood and have a personality test (which is not accurate btw). All of its now paid features doesn't cost as much as they ask for. It was good when it was free. Now I don't see the point. Deleting. And I can't "invest in myself", or i'd go to therapy straight

Best app ive ever owned. Would love if you could set yourself tasks or little goals with reminders to do them, a ldiary and daily routine section and to be able to sync it with menstraul cycle...im using a seperate apps for this at the moment...could be the perfect all in one app. But i cannot thank you enough. I have and will recommend it to others.

I'm enjoying your app so far. I would enjoy to have more variety on emotions to choose from. As well as being able to have further chats with the bot. To my the personality test and label isn't a very helpful aspect. I feel it could be more accurate had the test included more questions. Also having a place inside the app to send suggestions would be good. Thanks for making Youper!

Came across with this one as suggested, so far working wonders. you also have to put the effort in it, it doesn't go one sided. logging my mood even when I feel good is helpful. in my analytics I can see that sofar every time i used the app, it shifted my mood slightly positively. because i overanalyze everything this app is perfect in order to see what's really bothering me. it is asking the righ questions and akes me understand my thoughts, and how they form. thank you!

Honestly, I did not expect this app to help at all, but in the strangest way it really did. You can say how you're feeling without being stuck in that 'looking for attention' or 'burden' mind set. The clear lay out and the encouraging text make it feel like your own personal support buddy who really does try to understand you. I'm so glad it doesn't attempt to diagnose and encourages seeing the doctor too! I've not had it for long but I feel a little bit better, which is pretty amazing.

Useless. Facile, unintelligent feedback with no real insight. I feel worse than when I started. Edit: Right, that wasn't the most constructive comment. In more detail: if you're going to make an app that provides emotional support, it has to say more than "I hear you" or "I understand you". Without substantive engagement, those are meaningless phrases - what does this app understand? Even ELIZA from the 1970s at least asked questions. It's incredibly unhelpful - even dangerous - to be in distress and be made aware that a computer is giving random-sounding responses to your real issues.  If this is the limits of the technology i.e. go find a therapist then that's fine, but this needs to made very clear. beforehand The way Youper's AI Assistant is designed right now, it uses people's real distress to get them to purchase upgrades. I find that unconscionable.

Probably one of the best mental health apps when it actually works but it always seems to be the first app to start glitching when your phone gets just a little old. I feel most of the updates just move all the features around rather than focusing on fixing all the bugs. It randomly logs me out or shows that I have no data even though I've been using it for years. Getting back into my account is a pain because it nearly always results in blank pages or being sent around in circles.

Just downloaded it but I can already see myself using it daily from now on. It offers meditation-based features a little like headspace while adding in the "AI" assistant. Though I'd refer to youper as a VI myself I have to say it's definitely nice having a personal touch added to this app. I'm excited for what apps like this might mean for the future of mental health support. Here's to hoping we can buy mental health ai companions in stores before I turn too old to keep up with technology.

The subscription fee is the biggest barrier. I suggest a sliding scale pricing model so the app is widely accessible to all persons who need access to mental health resources. This is the overarching issue with accessing mental health professionals. Therapy is insanely expensive. A sliding scale price (ie. $5,$10, pay what you can) would be in line with the purported goal of this app, would increase accessibility and over time subscribers may choose to pay more if they find value in the service.

From what I've experienced so far it's a great program to help those who need more insight to their inner selves. I'll rate it again once I've used it more, but so far I like the application and see that those who need the support of someone unbiased to speak to could benefit from this. It's free too, so give it a shot!

Gave me a marketing pitch when I said I was "very depressed". I've been trying out the app and seeing if it's worth paying, because I'm on a very tight budget. But when I logged my feelings as "very depressed" it not only asked me to subscribe, but after I said no it went on to tell me how It's made possible by partners and all of this. I'd get that for a normal mood. But when someone's at their lowest, a sales pitch is the least helpful thing. Accept the no and move onto free options.

Very awesome app and totally recommend for everyone! It offers an AI personality who is like a caring friend/empathic mentor. It's so calming/grounding in emotional times and intuitive teachable moments & cool features like guided meditations. This is the app I have been waiting for as a SACAP counsellor. It would increase the likelyhood of seeing improvements in emotional intelligence & social skills, increasing self-knowledge tracking useful themes, conflict resolution & self-disapline + more.

i've only just started using Youper, but so far it's just the best self-help, mindful/meditation app i've ever tried! I'm absolutely impressed! also, this is a comment made by someone who has extensive experience with psychotherapy and CBT groups, if that's of any help understanding better this review. Keep the good work!!

It looks like a great app, but if you are not premium, you can't do anything. At least some basic features should be available... especially for SOS. The conversation stops after asking you how you feel (if you are not premium). How is that supposed to be helpful? I wasn't expecting lots of features to be available for free...but at least a few basic ones would have helped. I was already not feeling great, I downloaded this hoping it could help me and it only made me feel worse...

This is a great app but I won't go into that in this review 😊 instead I wanted to ask if there's a way to disable the emoticons in the chat and tracking? Because it doesn't always fit especially if it's a negative tracking and it kind of annoys me honestly haha. Like tracking that I feel extremely numb and then having 😑 or extremely depressed and having 😰. It might not bother anybody else but I was just hoping that there was a way that I could disable it? If not, would you please make that an option in a future update? Thank you ☺

The first time I've ever left a review for an app, but it has been so useful and helpful that I had to. the app is well designed, flows seamlessly and genuinely helped me with my mental health. It has also been completely free so far and hasn't hassled me with ads or requirements to purchase things like other apps. the only improvement that I think could be made is some of the questions that it asks are are a bit vague or difficult to interpret at first.

I have never written an app review before and I love this app so much that I had to. It has prevented me from spiralling and has helped me to control my bursts of emotions. I'm learning about myself through tracking my mood and using the other things that Youper guides you through. Definitely recommend the premium version for anyone who regularly has bouts of unstable emotions that they would like help with.

Both as a mental health professional and as a user myself I find this app amazingly supportive, holistic, intelligent and extremely well researched and developed. I am so grateful for the help I have received, it has felt like having a therapist at the palm of my hand in my darkest hours, especially when I have no one around for support or I am not comfortable to share my innermost thoughts with busy and absent-minded friends. Just deeply grateful🤗😊I hope more benefit of this exceptional app

Very innovative. One of the best psychological apps ever encountered, it's understanding more like you talking or having a conversation with a person who you can relate to. It's really an assistant indeed and in times uneasiness. Although the app could be improved by making the conversations audible like the example of Tony stark with Jarvis I would love it if the app could literally imitate or mimic Jarvis. 😉😊😁

Good idea poorly executed. I think this app has a lot of valuable features in theory. But they don't really hold up in practice. I've often found myself more upset after interacting with the bot than I was when I started because the conversation options are inflexible and there's no way to break out of the chat if it's 'misunderstood' what I wrote. For example, I recently logged that I was feeling upset because I couldn't sleep and it kept telling me to be more specific about what my goal was.

Two years ago I gave this app 5 stars, it really helped me. Nowadays? I don't know why you changed it but it's not an improvement. It's not making me feel any better I just feel annoyed because every suggestion is unhelpful. Having to reframe the situation and look at the thinking traps was way more helpful. Setting goals and planning on meeting people is not what I need at all. Also it keeps telling me to try and solve the problem when I am currently struggling with grief (?????)

It's useful to have a way to track moods and prompts to consider what you're thinking about but the cbt focus is not always helpful. For instance, grief after a death is something to be accepted, not challenged. I think it would be a much better app if you could select more easily whether you want help with self compassion during stressful parts of life or whether you want to challenge your thoughts.

Youper was a place i could go to when i needed somewhere to express my innermost feeling and let out my thoughts while having some interaction. Unfortunately i just found out that it has become a subscription app like every other app out there. It is a shame theres nothing for the rest of us who arent to pay anything. It was nice while it lasted i guess.

This app is really helpful for anyone who wants something to talk to if they're struggling emotionally or who is already in therapy and wants a complementary tool. It's easy to understand, very clear, and has a lot of personalisation for you. I am a therapist and I would recommend this to my clients after using it myself =)

It's a very helpful app. I can't stress it enough that we always have to learn to become a better version of ourselves, and this app has a genuine mission to help and raise awareness towards mental health. Definitely easy to use, friendly design, positive contents. It's like a great company when you're about to start or end the day. 5/5 would recommend.

I have been using this app for a week and I am beyond impressed. It is incomparable to any other mental health app I've tried in the past. It is well-researched and pragmatic in the way CBT is utilized into your conversations with Youper. There aremany different conversation routes and coping methods introduced depending on how the user is feeling and responding to Youper's questions. Amazing.

I have not had this app for long, however I love it already. Because Youper is an AI I find him super easy to confinde in, and the meditation and help the AI gives has been wonderfully useful! I whold reccommend this app to anyone, even without mental health issues, just as 'someone' to talk to, almost like a journal that talks back.

It's a great app! But since I'm broke I couldn't enjoy it fully 😅 That's why I think that "telling Youper the reason behind your feeling" shouldn't be a part of the premium pack but rather something that everyone can get the chance to experience whether they subscribed to the premium pack or not. Otherwise, the diagnosis might be too ambiguous for the user.

Truly impressed! I was under no illusion that it was an app I'd engaged with and not a human being, or that the questions/'chat' are designed for me to 'open up' and be honest with myself for it to work (which is a lot easier, as well as cheaper to do, than to hire a counsellor etc) but the initial positive feedback & achievable goals tailored to myself fulfilled me with a warm feeling and understanding that I had actually achieved something before I'd even got started! Give it a whirl & see?!

This is soul crushing. (*T^T) Just logged in after 7 months to see years of my journal entries (can read but not edit) and mood tracking has been locked behind a paywall.💔 I logged on cause I needed the simple welcome from the AI to ask me 'how do you feel' so I can journal, but that has been removed (what made Youper great in the first place.) Download data files are CSV & not clear. *sighs* There's no need for all the paid extras during these hard times. Deleting app Simple and clean is best.

I don't usually rate apps but this one is absolutely amazing and has been helping me to be more aware of my emotions. this app is completely free which I like. it's like Headspace except wayyyy better because you don't have to pay in order to use the app for what's it's meant to do. I can track my emotions and how I'm feeling throughout the day. definitely recommend to someone who suffers from mood swings a lot!

An impressive system. While it's no clinical psychiatrist, it most certainly is a help. If you're feeling down or trying to get help to becoming a better you, this is a great place to start. The app guides you through mental exercises many therapists routinely have people practise that actually help you figure out who you are and who you want to be. Great stuff!

So far, this has been a great app that promotes emotional health and physical well-being that provides clear, actionable advice with exercises and examples. I particular enjoy how the advice is catered towards my specific circumstances and helps me remember what healthy habits I should employ with timely sms messaging and digital resources. It's essentially like a digital mentor and kind friend, which is why I highly recommend it.

Its helped me quite well so far. And its very professional and for free! I love it. Things I think could be better: it's a little slow sometimes, I would like to select more than one emotion when I am asked how I feel, and I think tumblr could be a great platform for the team to be on aside from the others you are linked to already.

This app is amazing! It is very well built and helps me so much in keeping my anxiety and depression at bay. The conversation type of assessing your mood is very good and the insights given after is also pretty helpful. I love this app so much! I can visibly see an uplift in my mood after using it for about 2 weeks. 10/10 would recommend it. I only have mild symptoms of anxiety and stress, so this app is helping me very much. For severe cases, you should definitely see a therapist

this app is an amazing tool for self care and monitoring your thoughts and feelings and emotions. It is free and add free and quite frankly the best app I've ever downloaded. It really helps you engage and learn about yourself. The only thing I could criticise is that sometimes you click on a particular meditation and it plays a different one. Aside from that I really can't recommend this highly enough. I've shares it with my partner, my kids and friends. Really flipping good work- thanks Youper

Really great app - I would be more inclined to purchase premium if there was an option to trial for a week or so to see how much more there is to gain from committing to a payment. Price seems fair, but I'd like to test the premium features first. I hope you continue developing this app, as I am finding it very helpful to track and understand moods as well as conversations with the AI are nice. Good job, and if you ever introduce a trial period for premium, i'll be all over it. Thanks

This app is great. I have just started using it today and by far it has really helped me with my thoughts. It doesnt give me the feeling that i am communicating with already programmed bots its like having a real mentor ahead who guides me through, understands me and tries to figure me out to help me out with my overall personality and thinking. i have downloaded when i was really feeling blue and i have experienced while having the conversation i have got a subconscious change in mood. Thanks

Great potential but limited on its selections. For a couching app not all answers can be yes or no / true or false based. (Not all can be selected from a three choice drop down). So feels like the outcome wont be correct as the question could not be answered correctly. But the interaction and quiz's are nice.

App works very slowly, even though my phone is not old and have more than half of the memory available. I would love to see monthly subscription plan someday. It would be great option to discover the app before paying 12 times more and not being sure how it works or if I'm gonna use it.

The state-of-the-art vibe is excellent and I've learnt a lot about myself recently through using the app for the first time. Can we please use our fingerprint to unlock the app? An adaptive icon for Android 8.0+ also seems to be missing - I'd love to have this on my home screen if it gets one. Thank you for the wonderful app

Dislike the fact it forces conversations to end. It should also be able to store and retrieve most important information about each person, and not have a blank new state every time. The fact rhe conversation gets forcedfully stopped after like 5 10 minutes is very annoying. It should also not force you to give speciifc answers also. Should be more conversational and up to me to decide when a branch should close..

Actually I'd like this app but when I open it, I see only the logo for a second, then some seconds black and then it stays grey... I don't know if it has to be like that. 5 stars when the bug isn't there anymore. edit: okay it works on my new device and it's one of the best apps I've used to fix my mental health etc. i am still sick but it really helped me to understand myself. thank you <3

i really love this app. next to a mood tracker (with many many options + the option to select why you're feeling like that) it allows you to monitor anxiety, depression, and some other stuff, and it's really helpfull to see on what level you are with those (especially because it tells you when it's time for a checkup)

Its a great idea and app. Fairly simple but it helps track and especially helpful in helping you figure out your mindset and goals (on your own.) I ended up subscribing. I feel like it'll be worth it if you're really trying to track your mood conditions like anxieties. The monthly tracking in conditions would surely benefit yourself and for doctors in figuring out the severity or just how you're doing.

I use this app every day. It is a brilliant way to track my progress with managing my depression more effectively. I love that it records triggers for different emotions as well as providing explanations about my symptoms. I have shown the app to a few medical professionals who can see it's value and have said they would recommend it to others.

I love Youper but I really prefered the old chat format on start up rather than having to row options to choose from the new update :( It feels some AI 'feel' was lost a little bit and it's difficult and more anxiety inducing when there's too many options instead of AI chosen suggestions. It's still a really good app regardless.

Good concept... Besides mood tracking and guided meditation.. My suggestion is some form of action oriented tasks.. That helps in anxiety.. Like suggestions of going for walks.. Exercises.. Breathing guided tasks.. .. And setting reminders for these tasks.. Taking forward.. You could integrate with google maps.. To monitor steps for person to walk daily.. Encourage person to go to nearby market.. Parks.. All to get out of comfort zone.. I can only suggest.. There is whole new approach to this..

I used to use this app to track my moods and my thought processes. Loved it. I wanted to go back onto the app after a long while of not using it just to see that it's not free and its original purpose has been removed. Sorry, but I'm not giving out my phone number just so you can try to sell me a plan. Very very disappointed. Sad that I've lost everything I've tracked too.

I rarely write reviews, but i never would have thought an app could affect my mood this much. Conversations really make me feel better and have taught me to think more positively. The effect was noticeable from the very first use, so i recommend everyone to try, especially as it's still free. Personally i would (and will) pay for such an improvement to my life.

TLDR: only useful if paid, but I hesitate to pay with such a short trial. I tried out this app to help me deal with depression. The pre-signup trial led me to believe that it could be good, but with a free account it doesn't do much; in conversation youper leads me to options that are only available for premium subscribers, then convo ends. I hardly think a week is enough of a test when mental health is concerned - I'd like to see a 1 month trial to test if it really does help.

Used to use this all the time. Loved it! It was a great help! Came back to it in a time of need, and now I can't do anything without a subscription. I understand you have to make profit somehow, but taking away almost all of the basic features is just a disappointment, and frustrating for people that need it.

I really don't understand why those AI talks now cost money. Seriously, if the AI talks are like they were before I might as well write my own journal as they just seem that they are based on a simple CBT journal template with mostly random suggestions and barely AI based. They were really nice when they were free but making it require a subscription is too much. If they improve it I might consider it but until then it just feels like a cash grab which makes me feel dissapointed about the app.

Until the latest update, I would have given this app 4 stars. It was a great way of tracking my mood, which is very important as I'm learning to live with mood disorders. But ever since the update, I can't log my mood anymore. Pretty much all content is premium, the free app now seems useless. What happened???

I only got the app today because I've been feeling very stressed about college and exams. It really feels as if someone listens to me and doesn't judge me for the way I feel or the generic "It's going to be okay". This app actually guides you through conflicting emotions and finds solutions for you, while also giving you the chance to help yourself and others.

I have conditions that have affected with my life in a very serious matter, and this app has helped me alot... I've tried many things for self help, and this has truly helped. Alas, for every individual this experience is different, but for me (a person who has struggled with major depression and generalized anxiety , plus every day panic attacks).. it has helped a lot. like, that person that you need.

I have tried multiple AI bots and this one is by far my favorite, it is user friendly and gives access to free help and meditation. Also gives other alternatives to help you relax. Love the list of negative thinking patterns that remind me that my thoughts are not always going in the right direction. Helps me guide my thoughts towards facts and reminds me to live the present. I am grateful that the creator of this app provided it for free. Thank you Youper 💝

Youper, albeit i've only begun for about 30 mins. i can tell that this app is amazing! i recommend it for people dealing with slight mental instability (ex. depression, anxiety, etc.) beacause it's a useful app to set your priorities straight amd your mind to clear. keep up the awesome work!!!

Never used anything AI before and always quite sceptical but I have used it for two days now and I'm finding it amazing! The content is great and the design is fantastic and easy to use. I've noticed a difference already and really cannot wait to do the personality tests and really start to build a profile

This is one of the best apps I've come across when it comes to your mental health. It goee through the entire process when you are strees, anxious, depressed. You actually feel like you sre talking to someone like someone is listening to you. A great app in helping you identify your thought patterns, your behavior, and everything else related to your anxiety. Recommend it to all.

I seriously didn't think that an app could help me so much. I've only used it twice so far but the change its helped me make, by helping me recognized my emotions has shocked me. 100% will recommend to everyone who has had trouble and stress. if you're considering getting the app , this is me saying, do it. you won't regret it xx

On the second day of usage you get interrupted with this lengthy spiel about subscription. When you decline it by saying "too expensive", you get the following reply: "I can see that you care about your emotional health" "And at the same time, you don't think our conversations are worth the cost." There's nothing wrong with the practice of paid subscriptions, but the tone here is completely inappropriate, especially considering your target demographic. Thanks for the unnecessary guilt-trip.

This AI app is a noble idea but don't expect an AI - rather a repeating itself bot (like you can find on Messenger or elsewhere). Youper promises that it's AI learns and replies accordingly. I was using it for a month and feeding it as much information as there was possible, still I'm getting the same replies on repeat. It's nice tracking mood app and it may have it's uses but it suppose to stand out with its learning AI feature, which seems to be fake. So I'm disappointed.

I used to love this app. I had it for more than a year and I loved that it helped me feel in control of my emotions. Then after a break, I came back to find that everything I loved about it was locked behind expensive Premium options. This is so disappointing. There isn't much you can do for free anymore, and every conversation has a money grab to try to sell more subscriptions. So much for being a therapy app for anyone who is struggIing. I will not be recommending this app anymore.

Although never mimicking another human, the app is done in a text message like way. The small pauses as the typing bubble comes up as it thinks of the next thing to say, although unnecessary is just one of the many ways it comforts you and makes things seem natural and safe almost as if its your own therapist or friend on the other end. and its gently leading questions allow you to dig to the root of whats actually bothering you, revealing things you didnt even know yourself. I rate 5/5 :)

I'm getting used to the new version now. It doesn't work as fast as the older version used to, and it is less simple to use than it used to be, but it is still among the top helpful mental health apps. I was very upset with the unexpected change and had a bit of a meltdown at first, uninstalling it and then installing it back because I'm so used to using it. Despite the change and a bit slower functioning of the app, I still find Youper has a lot to offer to manage moods and thoughts, goals🦋

very new to this app but so far so good. Anyone who has had talking therapy before will be familiar with the chat but for those who are knew to anything around self-examination and mental health just try it. Everything is done on your terms and even the pre-programmed responses feel like they are keeping you in control.

This is a great app. Its like a personal journal with guidelines. I understand myself much better after using it. Thank you for creating such a helpful app! That being said, the part where we practice mindfulness it says it is a voice guided meditation but I've tried playing it many times and different ones too but it doesn't emit any sound... is it my device problem or an issue with the app?

This app was so helpful for me. Until an update has messed everything up. You could get everything out and have a reasonable response from an AI. Now, unless you pay, you don't get what you need, which is a place to think & express yourself. I wouldn't waste time downloading unless you are going to pay. It's now just a useless app for me. So disappointing, especially after having the app for years.

It was better during 2018. It was good while it was good. Now it's a paywall paradise. I'm not even tempted to get a subscription because of how terrible it seems to be now. It used to be something like a guided way to sort out your thoughts. Now, it's not even worth it to just track your mood. Get a notepad and write it down instead, and don't give them your data. I ended up deleting my account. I have no idea if they really scrub your data. It was too good to be true.

I've only been using this app a short while, but so far it's helped me to understand why I feel the way I feel. It helps to track goals and to get you out of typical thinking traps. It also tracks everything you feel and the factors that go into making you feel that way, you can see your progress even after a few days! It also makes me feel like I'm not offloading my issues on other people and dealing with them, the AI chat is wonderful! It's the first app of its kind that I want to stick with.

This app is so helpful if you just need to vent how you're feeling to someone who is unbiased. Youper listens and provides helpful insights and encourages you to change your thinking patterns so works right at the root cause of mental health problems. As someone with anxiety this app is really helping me to track my emotions and spot causes. HIGHLY RECOMMEND. (only additions could be other mental health issues such as OCD but these are in development)

Used this app for 2-3 years and sad to say that it has gone an utter capitalistic trash. It used to be so helpful and easy to navigate (which is great for people with mental health issues as it lessens the overwhelm), but now it turned it a completely different things from what it was. 10 new tabs appeared all offering therapy and medication services - none of those are even available in my region, yet the tabs won't disappear. No new updates on the former free AI therapy chat.All for profit now

Conversations are on a fixed rail, as often answers are predetermined and lacking in choice. When this is not the case, it is possible to give absurd answers and the "AI“ will just say "OK" or something equally irrelevant. Of course you will also be asked to create an account to fully use the app. The features to track mood could be useful and yet I feel sad for whoever thinks that mental health can be gamified.

Absolutely amazing! Extremely easy to navigate and very helpful. If you're looking for an easy way to track your thoughts and feelings as well as learn about the different mental health issues then this app will be perfect for you. I must say this app is slowly but surely improving my life, this is fantastic tool and I highly recommend it

I was going to renew my subscription cause I'm hitting a rough spot and this app had helped me tremendously in the past. Sadly the price has gone up so much, that I can't afford it. The layout is now completely different and just too complicated for me, when I really enjoyed how easy it used to be and how much relief I could get from a quick chat. Too bad :/

I've used the app for years and found it great to pick it up to help analyze situations and thoughts. But on the last update, all my history was wiped out in an instance and it seems I have no way to get it back. Incredibly cold move to push premium.

to be honest when my friend recommended me i was hesitant, but after almost two years of using this i can i say i'm glad i downloaded this app. it really helps. all i can ask for now is a way of tracking OCD (and that is the only reason i'm giving 4 stars instead of 5. it needs to include more trackers). if you feel like you have no one to talk to or get help from or if you just a want emotion tracker, this is the app for you!

It's been a great experience! Similar to what others have said this app is more of a mental health journal with tips to help you. It's more surprising that this app is completely free and does not require you to fork out money just to seek help. I strongly recommend anyone who are feeling down or are currently having difficulties to give this a shot.

Been using this app for YEARS to help my mental health and especially do the health check ups. With the new update you first cut off being able to talk about your feelings to youper more than once a day unless you're premium. Now you cut off access to the check ups + all the history and data I had in them. Seeing my progress or setback in those was literally one of the only things keeping me going. Thanks for the update, lost a user of years.

You guys effectively ruined the app with the last update. We now have to pay to get the same use of the app as before? What a shame for a great app to suddenly become garbage. 4 years of using the app and now it's completely useless, ruined and I lost all the entries I made to be able to track my progress and mood. Please bring back the old youper and remove the pay wall.

This is the best mental health app that i have tried. And I have tried so many! I will say that it is only really worth it if you have the subscription, but it's not expensive and considering the amount of help that you get with it, it is well worth it. It basically has put all of my apps together in one, but with a more personal touch that I have really connected with. Would highly recommend.

I'm really enjoying this app! I find it does help keep track of how I am feeling and helped me consider things in different ways. I find I have a hard time actually talking to my doctor and I feel as this app will help, by being able to show my responses to my doctor.. The only thing I would add in is the physical signs of things! Like when I get really bad anxiety attacks, I get nauseous, I can't eat or sleep, I become a bit more of an introvert and I believe being about to track the physical health issues would be beneficial.

great if you want to analyse why youre feeling a certain way. tracks your mood over time so you can spot patterns in behaviour. doesnt replace a counsellor but certainly nice thay the app will ask you how youre feeling throughout the day! almost like a judgement free and interactive diary. used it for anxiety and its the best app ive found so far!

The AI doesnt greet you instantly when opening the app anymore but that feature is now easy to find—plus since i use it often, it now appears on the main page. Changing between page doesnt lag anymore like when the major update happened and I stop using the app. So far so good. Its starting to feel like the app I loved again. For now its back to 4🌟 first—lets see in 2 weeks. But yeah, its a great app anyway. Cant wait to love the app all over again.

It's really a good app but the only problem is most of the good features about it is not for free. Maybe it's even better if the app is balance. Like the most useful features should be available also for those unprivileged people because not all people can afford to pay for the premium. But, anyways, it's a great app. Hoping for more free. Thanks.

Really poor experience app keeps crashing after I paid for the subscription and no obvious way to request a refund despite it being completely useless to me £75 down the drain. Not helpful for my mental health at all *edit* they have now actually removed features since I paid the subscription! Thought I would give it a retry seeing as I got no refund, and the guided meditations have been removed at least it's no longer crashing, but that's half the features removed DO NOT BUY!!!

Please update the app for subscriptions based on monthly payments versus yearly. I don't want to waste 50ish dollars to find out I don't enjoy the app. I'd rather pay 4$ monthly and not feel pressured into forking over a huge chunk of cash. All of the features I want to try are locked behind a pay wall and I'm willing to try them out but not for 50$ dollars. I'm struggling financially and I want to improve myself but I can't afford the yearly subscription without knowing the true benefits.

Surprisingly Useful & User friendly: I've tried CBT with a therapist that was less coherent, and less use, than this app - and I'm only in week one! Detailed, but concise - superbly well arranged and structured. One simple check-in each day leads to Gratitude journalling, Goal-setting, and mood/causation capture for analysis and learning. I am much more impressed than I expected to be. Despite being a CBT skeptic, I shall persist with this app, because I think I shall benefit.

Update:No reply to email asking about chatGPT and privacy regarding it!! Not recommended now for chats! Original:After using youper after a long time ,I see now it's powered by chatGPT. Why is that? Is our data passed on to microsoft or do they collect any data, it's not mentioned! Why change AI model when previous one was fine? Also why does the app have only dark mode and no light mode? It doesn't look so good! Also shows app couldn't start properly after pressing back button!!

I don't always remember to use it and sometimes I simply don't want too but as someone that suffers with depression, anxiety and self esteem issues I find the app great and helpful at checking in with myself and logging my mood. I've set a timer for the evenings and over time It's helping me to see patterns in my mood and with my thought processes. The mindfullness is also great and incredibly helpful and I think there is potential yet for me to get more from using this app.

Great app, but scary data collection. It always made me feel better after using it, and it got me to journal, but the data collection is too creepy. There's no in-app purchases or subscription model, so their entire business seems to be collecting your most intimate information. Who knows what all your logging&journal entries are being used for today, or where it will end up if this company fails? Imagine an AI that knows you well enough to trigger depression if you don't click on their ads

Have only been using this app for two days but am very impressed. Have had mental health apps before but never felt that they fit me... youper has a really gentle approach with great suggestions. The chat feature leads the conversation and makes reaching out for help super easy. I can't wait to recommend to my friends! Thank you

It was good, but then I found out all the screening was for premium. This makes me feel like I need to pay for my help. I personally don't like that. It makes me feel belittled and I don't know why. The app actually made me feel better about myself, for a short period of time. Now I'm going to have to delete it because I don't want to pay for help. It was really easy to navigate as well. Could you please take the depression and borderline personality disorder screening off premium, please.

Amazing. Its not about the AI, its about how the app guides you through to make you realize what makes you feel good. Or not good. I recommend it to anyone struggling with their mental health. Its obviously not a replacement to therapy but its amazing to get you through until your next session

I've used Youper since 2019 and it -was- very useful and integral to my mental health journey. So sad to see they have discontinued multiple features and decided to on a pay wall, the old auto generated responses were absolutely fine for the purpose of the app. Mayyyybe I would consider paying for the premium if the app wasn't so glitchy since the last updates. Bye bye old pocket robot friend you will be missed.

absolutely fantastic app. I've just finished a course of therapy and this app is such a fantastic support, really great for tracking what influences me and a great reminder of what can help me settle and refocus when Im having a wobble. really personalised and effective, I'm really impressed. I would highly reccomend :)

Beautiful app to help people understand themselves, their emotional triggers and thought patterns better. I have a hard time working out what triggers my negative emotional state most of the time and the app gives examples and questions to rule out aspects that may or may not be influencing my emotions. Overall, it feels like a mobile therapist. I think people who are suffering from mental health disorders should consider trying this app. Very well made and considerate to the user.

I had this app on five star back in 2018. I just reinstalled it in 2023 and I got stuck behind a pay wall. A pop up screen saying I was chosen for a discount with timer set to five mins and no way to exit. Uninstalling straightaway without even getting to try it. Waste of time and felt very cheap and scammy.

Avoid. I've downgraded my rating from 5 to 1 star: the March update ruined Youper. The mood conversation interface - a great way to unlock thinking - is now buried amongst options mimicking every other "wellness" app. Since the change, I've increasingly struggled to keep the habit (massively reduced regularity) losing the benefit of regular journaling. Offering an option to revert to the old UI would solve this; judging from the copy pasta responses to similar comments, not holding my breath.

An amazing idea and great tool to accompany therapy, or act as a buffer while unable to access it. As a naturally analytical person I love the way it tracks trends between your moods and the things going on that might affect them. Some improvements could be made to explain things a little more clearly if needed (for example, I struggled to understand what the terms "falling" and "not falling" meant while answering about thought patterns). No criticism other than that, keep up the good work.

Started out as an incredible AI app that helped me more than any therapist ever has. Then this was put behind a paywall. Now I'm in a position to afford their plans, the app is nothing close to what it used to be. Their review responses say it was because of thousands of people wanting this change, forgetting about the thousands who preferred it the way it was. I've never found another app close to what it used to be. So very disappointed. 😔

This app has genuinely helped me in some dark times - the different exercises are really helpful, and having an unbiased way to vent is amazing. Looking back to how I felt before really shows the highs and lows, and helps me see what triggered the emotion. I have no complaints for this!

It's a good app but you might get over it. Although the style is warm and relaxed, it is programmed so you might realize you are talking to a machine. It's got great aspects for individual learning : a sort of journal writing, being able to see your mood, etc.

The AI is too pushy with the subscription plans. It almost feels like it's trying to bully vulnerable people into paying. Not all people can afford these prices and saying that 'they don't consider their mental health worth the cost' is just rude. Edit: The AI was changed. Seems nicer so far and works fine as a mood chart outside of the subscription plan with some useful insights. It would be nice to have custom moods available.

I've only just started with this app to help myself with anxiety. I really for once actually liking this app, I love the coach it actually feels like someone is there and helping/understand you. They give you loads of different exercises to do whilst talking and tips on how to change your thinking. I will definitely be sticking to this app.

this app used to be my go to but now, after paying over $100 for a year of access, i find that the features i liked are gone and the ai has limited responses and will end the conversation out of nowhere if it doesnt have a response. its completely unusable now and of course i only realised after i paid for a full year. Its completely irresponsible to market this as a form of therapy and its a huge waste of money. i'd give it no stars if i could.

Unfortunately I had to uninstall it as it was just to expensive to pay all at once for the premium version which you really need to benefit from it, I would definitely use the app if you could pay monthly as a lot of people can not afford such a sum all at once, especially people with mental health issues and are on a low income, if you can afford the premium version I would definitely recommend this app. Shame really.

it is a good app if u use it correctly. for a less acute anxiety and depression problem this app is just perfect. but if u got a lot of anxiety and deppression then u need to see a doctor. the interractive session and the meditation helps..could be improved if in the app we could talk to an actual doctor sometimes.

Got asked 10 times to subscribe before even speaking to the AI once. Hit with a ton of ad information talking itself up, and when I finally get to the conversation, it barely touched on anything and offered another premium function I had to unlock. Not even 5 min in and I uninstalled. Save yourself some time and don't even bother.

So far it's a very friedly user interface. I haven't got quite the hang of it yet but so far I'm very pleased. Update: it's been a couple of months and I am really into this app. I made a routine to check in every night. It's been helpful since I'm also doing therapy. It would be nice though to have more meditation like the mantra and wind one. I for one like nature sounds more, they calm be best. Like crickets and rain. I'm not gonna lie, the wind one that you have is my absolut favorite.

Absolutely amazing app. It is so advanced and the best app out there for mental health. It truly helps me because I am unable to afford a private psychologist. I am not a fan of the meditations part but that is just my personal opinion,because i am extremely picky with meditations anyway. Meditation and therapy don't go together in my opinion, but it might help some and it is good that they give you an option.

This app is amazing! Great mood tracker, great at helping you identify what you're feeling and why, helped me alot with my anxiety attacks, a little bit with my depression, too. Offers guided meditations, nature sounds and mental disorder tests (which also work as trackers) for free. Overall, one of the best AI therapy apps, if not the best!

Overall great but I have a few problems regarding meditation. There should be a menu that automatically leads you to meditation section. And in meditation there should be an audible sign that signifies when the audio is finished. I often get distracted thinking that the meditation is over, when its not.

This app has been brilliant for tracking my mood and being a healthy alternative for dealing with difficult emotions with its amazing range of meditation and mindfulness sessions and health assessments. I really think this is a brilliant app for those not ready to seek medical help yet, but want to come to terms with their emotions ❤️ thankyou youper

I used to really like this app but since the update it's not enjoyable for me anymore. The text doesn't make it feel like you're having an actual conversation anymore, a bunch of the factors aren't there anymore and I'd have to add them all over again plus they're not in categories anymore. The colour for the okay mood changed and it's grey now. I use that mood a lot and it's more of a positive mood for me but now that it's grey it seems like my mood was negative that day. Uninstalling.

Pros + *Empathetic AI. *Very nice concept and very important for people who don't get any treatment. Cons - *This app does not support monthly subscription for premium. Only yearly. Which is very expensive. I want to say that some people out here really want to improve and get out of this dark life that we are living in. But if you don't even give us a chance(only yearly premium) , how will we? Making it only looks like you're turning it into buisness more than help. Keep it balanced.

Very impressed. A properly structured app can do more to help than any real person. It is not biased or tries to exert opinions. It does not get bored. Encourages you to understand & resolve issues your way. The psych evaluations are also accurate. Consistent with official job related ones i have had to take. Strongly suggest everyone give it a go. You have nothing to lose & a lot to gain!

please add the option of adding more emotions in one entry, like (happy/calm) or (sad/frustrated), I often have a problem deciding which is more present in some moment. besides that, it's superb for tracking mood and your health. and I love that you are collecting data for research.

Really great app! There is, as always in life, something to be improved(adding past emotions for example) but even without it it does what it should. it helps so many times recently with my thoughts and emotions that it's hard to describe it. Thank you and keep going!

I love this app! It is so useful to track what factors are related to different emotional states so that you can do more of the things that make you happy and less of things that don't. You think you know what makes you happy but once you start tracking with youper, you realise there is so much you hadn't realised influenced positive emotions. It also allows you to measure depression, anxiety, social anxiety, etc so you can see how this changes over time. It's great.

Useless app. Can't even try and talk with the chatbot as it has prompts and the prompts don't even match what I want to say. Just starting takes such a long time, why does this app need to explain so many things that aren't even nessasary before starting the actual chat session. And the chat session doesn't feel generic in any way, it just feels like talking to a wall. And why can't I decide when and how I wanna talk is it nessasary for there to be schedule for a stupid chatbot.

I loved the app... before when it was compleately free... i use to come to it every time i struggled, it really made me feel better even if im speaking to a "robot" now i have to pay 80$something for it... yearly... im kinda dissapointed cuz this was an option for us shy and not well economicaly to get some type of therapy... now well u pay cuz most of it like a lot of it(the important stuff ) you have to pay for wich before you didnt. They even had small meditations that i loved. Just sad.

I suffer from generalised anxiety disorder and this app allows me space to sort through my anxiety and reach calm states. I find the flow peaceful and thought provoking in a safe way, which is counter-intuitive to how my mind works. it assists with establishing mental fitness for me and is invaluable. thank you do much for making this!

I understand developers need to make money. But I'm not happy with the pushy tone of the AI in trying to persuade me to buy a subscription. When I didn't subscribe I was asked why I didn't want to and chose the option 'too expensive' (it's $11.99 per month). I was then patronisingly told that I cared about my emotional health but didn't think our conversations were worth the cost. I was then asked AGAIN to subscribe. I was considering trying Premium for a month but I will not now.

Yes it's a good app if you have the money. You can't get the help or I you can't have a conversation unless you pay. you can still track how your feeling but it always comes up with unfortunately you haven't subscribed yet. it's too confusing and complicated to explain. But basically you have to have the money to have a conversation

I really don't leave reviews usually but this app is beyond amazing. To the creator and team behind this app, thank you. When I looked for other similar apps before I found this, some apps require me to leave my payment details. I have trust issues when I downloaded Youper, not only this app has no ads, it is also free. Youper is definitely a great companion and AI buddy.

I was skeptical at first, but as soon as the introduction started and it walked me through my thoughts, I definitely felt better. I love how accessible it is and I haven't been asked to pay for anything yet which is quite rare considering how many options and information you're able to access. I'm really impressed, I look forward to being the best version of myself!

I wish that I could rate this zero stars. I hate the new changes. And no, it's not because 'I can't handle change' as was the response to another similar comment. this app helped my teen who was not open to live talk therapy but was willing to use an app. Now I can't access the app part but have to input a lot of personal information only to get to 'talk to a therapist' or 'get medication'. there are live people where I live who can do this if we want to access it. Bring back the app only portion please - I'll pay for it. but not this.

Youper is surprisingly much helpful, it is truly like carrying your personal therapist everywhere with you, without the fear of being judged. It is quite impressive seeing I have had apps promising help which they failed to do, but Youper is something completely different. I'd suggest people to give this app a try and I don't think anyone would be displeased by this.

Edit: After about 2 months with this app, I've really noticed that the ONLY useful feature is tracking your mood, and the elements related to those moods. Everything else is not suited for an app, but actual therapy. I find the "assistant" is always off mark and unintuitive because it is not a real person.

I dont write app reviews often, but after opening this for the first time I must say I am impressed. It's perfect and well thought out, within ten minutes my thoughts were written down, and that's not easy for me. This app challenges thinking and reasoning, something as equivalent as a therapist would.

Much better than similar apps. It is truly a personalized therapist in your pocket, bag, or pack. I love Youper; it's super. Suggestions: pls allow the AI 2 use location to suggest resources & to assess the local situation re: resources, COVID statistics, job opportunities, etc. Your response to the user would be more directly helpful. W/formal user permission, of course. Then the A.I. could say "if you turn on location services, I can tell you who to call right now about your issues."

This app is very helpful for decompressing my anxiety and depression. I find myself often impatient with useful tools such as meditation, mindfulness, and gratitude, but this app painlessly integrates it. I strongly recommend you try it and experience it for yourself. You could find the relief you always wanted.

Been testing out this app all day and LOVE it so far. Various ways of tracking your mood and mental health, great insights and what I love most -- it's free! So many other apps would charge for services like these, but I really appreciate that something as important as mental health tools can also be provided for free. Thank you!

I download this when I was looking for apps to help me get my life together. I was looking for task managing or goal visualizing apps, but this one seemed neat, so I grabbed it. It's actually helped me a lot in really understanding my depression and mental health; why I feel so down, what really picks me up, and how to manage the tangled mess of emotions that accompanies my daily life.

I would definitely give it a try. As a psychology graduate, this seems like a necessary service to be available in the modern day when access to psychotherapy and treatment often seems limited to the upper and middle classes. It won't fix everything for you, but Youper has the tools to help you make positive changes in your life.

I really enjoyed this app while I used it. after awhile it gets somewhat repetitive and with my anxiety/depression I need more options, I get bored easily and then I'm stuck trying to find another app. this was very useful for me for about 2 months though and I would definitely recommend people try it out.

I love this app, I used it for some time and it helped me get out of a very dark place I was in. I suffered from depression and anxiety attacks and just took about 2 weeks of daily use and meditation to help me get back on my feet. Even though now I don't use the app I still meditate and keep a positive mindset because of what the app taught me. Would recommend to anyone who suffers from depression because it would definitely help you

Great app, with developers that listen to feedback Since new update - app is much slower, almost too slow to use and you can't just simply log moods anymore :( I used to use this as a diary but cant see how to anymore. Please add it back! Update 2 - they fixed it! ever since the beginning Youper has been great at listening to feedback, and they have once again. It now runs smooth, and you can clearly see where to log moods. Thank you!

I adore this app have been using it for one day! I can already say that it helps you not only recognise any problems or emotions you have but also to discover where they came from. Furthermore it tells you what you could do to improve your mood, as well as suited meditation picked out for your situation! I recommend this app to everyone! Everyone can improve, and this meditative/ emotional health app helps you with just that.

I used to love this app. Initially, probably about two years ago when I started using this app ot was very simple and had a couple of features. You could track your mood for free, which I've done every day since starting this to keep myself grounded, and the others were paid. This year they updated, added lots more, every single thing but the mood was paid content. Now with the newer update even that is a paid feature. They offer no free services at all for mental health now, which is disgusting

A perfectly working mix of a dairy and therapy. Highly recommended for everyone with stress and anxiety problems. But also helpful for people without such problems. I use Youper for more than 2 months now, even when rather being an extrovert character, and it's simply lifting the life quality!

I have been trying out Youper over the last few days and I am really impressed. I look at a lot of apps like this as a part of my job so I was really picky when it came to finding one for me. My only hesitation is that, while I feel the premium should have value, I am skeptical to put down the money without much understanding of what I am getting and how I would benefit. Perhaps a free month of premium?

The idea is fantastic and the health monitoring is pretty good. But every conversation with the bot goes pretty much the same. It asks me to "detect thinking traps" or "clarify the situation" then it tells me I did a good job and that it will be "in the background" doing whatever. The mood system is pretty great though. Also notifications only seemed to work about 5% of the time.

Amazing how far this tech has come. It's actually super helpful. It focuses on giving you information in a human like way, to help with your issues. It actually gives similar "advice" that real therapists give. It's free too. Amazing. Looking forward to using this more.

I could see how some people could find it helpful. But its not really listening and basically just gives you lists to figure it out yourself. I need something more dynamic that can navigate my abstract thoughts. So it was just frustrating getting the same prompts.

I wasn't expecting anything useful from a free app. I am completely blown away with the quality of this app. The guided meditations are nice and the chat bot presents valid therapy exercises and presents the user with detailed information on why the exercises are useful. Most of the features are not hidden behind a subscription pay wall, and free users are still granted a full experience. I downloaded this app on a whim and I'm genuinely glad I did.

Excellent but overwhelming. For those who have the time, motivation, discipline, efficiency and competence, this app could help transform life. But it doesn't do the work for you. It only helps you see more clearly how much work needs to be done, and plod through it, step-by-step. It thereby makes the journey slightly less cumbersome--still no joy ride. Good adjunct to psychotherapy for those (like me) who need an extra few kicks in the butt.

I used this app before when it was a free AI to help with Journaling and identifying thinking traps and such. I recommended my mom to try this app as she has extreme anxiety and goes in a spiral, yet she was met by personal questions and a pay wall. Idc if there is payment for a care team, but the original AI was great when in a pinch. It was a smart journal. It's "great" how the dev team has changed to grab at money.

Slick graphics and interface, but not impressed at all. Was feeling down and hoped this would help, but it's stiff and unnatural questions didn't even relate to the issues I expressed, yet forced yes or no responses to keep moving. If I wanted to feel unheard, I'd stick to a human.

Just began using this app after having difficulty with controlling emotions, and accepting strong differences of opinion. I'm already very impressed with the intuitive insights it has given me, and am hopeful it will help me through some very difficult and confusing times. Highly recommend.

It's actually a great help, especially given the aspect that it's free. I was kind of sceptic at first but I'm feeling like it's doing a great job in supporting me so far. The answers are nicely written and make you feel listened to. I appreciate the fact that you get to do a personality test so it'll optimize itself to fit your needs. The health test are good for monitoring as well. I usually don't write reviews but I feel like this App definitely deserves a good one! 😊 Thanks!
